台股盤前要聞 

1.台北金融市場19日「股匯雙殺」再現，受到美股震盪及國際避險情緒升溫影響，外資持續大舉撤資，三大法人合計賣超台股899.54億元，加權指數一度重挫941點，台積電 (2330-TW) (TSM-US) 等權值股尾盤急拉，終場下跌289.18點，收在46822.08點。匯市在資金大量淨匯出壓力下，新台幣兌美元匯率開低走低，盤中一度觸及32.572元低點，終場重貶1.07角收在32.445元，兩大外匯市場爆出38.53億美元的大量。
2.近期台股波動加劇，引發市場對「熊市」的擔憂，19日立法院財政委員會高度關注政府監理工具與當沖降稅政策。金管會主委彭金隆強調，監理機關首重尊重市場機制，目前交易秩序仍屬理性，暫無實施限空或禁空等人工干預措施；針對 2027 年底到期的當沖降稅優惠，金管會規劃於明年 2、3 月召開公聽會廣徵各界意見，再行定奪。
3.台積電(2330-TW)及其日本子公司JASM提出的熊本二廠生產計畫變更申請，獲日本政府核准，將改為生產3奈米製程邏輯晶片，隨著計劃的調整，JASM設備投資總額預計將超過230億美元。
4.國票金控(2889-TW)19日召開第三季法說會，前 3 季累計稅後純益達 36.92 億元、年增 116.29%，EPS 達 1.01 元，其中國票證券獲利大增 3 倍創歷史新高。面對美國聯準會(Fed)通膨風險升高、貨幣政策偏緊且年底仍具升息空間的環境，經營團隊展現靈活韌性，未來將持續執行債券置換策略，在控制存續期間的前提下，進一步提高整體養券利差。
5.台積電19日一度跌至2390元，摜破季線關卡，拖累大盤一度跌逾900點，回測季線，不過在台積電力守平盤下，跌幅收斂終場跌289.18點或0.61%，收46822.08點，守住季線，成交量8251.01億元。外資今天繼續提款，賣超767.42億元，連9賣，續砍台積電，並同步減碼多檔記憶體。

paras_en: Taiwan’s pre‑market briefing notes that on the 19th the Taipei financial market saw a repeat “stock‑and‑currency double‑kill.” Driven by volatile U.S. equities and heightened global safe‑haven sentiment, foreign investors kept pulling out large sums, with the three major institutional groups net‑selling NT$89.954 billion of Taiwanese stocks. The weighted index plunged as much as 941 points before ending down 289.18 points at 46,822.08. Major chips such as TSMC (2330‑TW, TSM‑US) rallied sharply at the close but still finished lower. In the foreign‑exchange market, heavy net outflows pressured the New Taiwan dollar, which opened lower and fell to a intraday low of NT$32.572 per US$, closing down 1.07 ¢ at NT$32.445. Two major FX markets saw a combined outflow of US$3.853 billion.

Recent volatility in Taiwan’s equity market has sparked worries of a bear market. On the 19th the Legislative Yuan’s Finance Committee closely examined the government’s supervisory tools and the tax‑break policy for day‑trading. Financial Supervisory Commission (FSC) Chairman Peng Jin‑long stressed that regulators must first respect market mechanisms; trading remains orderly and rational, and there are currently no plans to impose short‑selling caps or bans. Regarding the day‑trading tax‑reduction incentive that expires at the end of 2027, the FSC will hold public hearings in February‑March next year to gather stakeholder input before making a decision.

TSMC (2330‑TW) and its Japanese subsidiary JASM have received approval from the Japanese government to amend the production plan for the second Kumamoto fab. The facility will now produce 3‑nanometer logic chips, and the revised plan lifts the total equipment investment to exceed US$23 billion.

Guotai Securities Holding (2889‑TW) held its Q3 earnings briefing on the 19th. Cumulative net profit after tax for the first three quarters reached NT$3.692 billion, up 116.29% year‑on‑year, with EPS of NT$1.01. Guotai Securities’ profit tripled to a historic high. Facing higher inflation risk from the U.S. Federal Reserve, tighter monetary policy and still‑available rate‑hike room at year‑end, management highlighted its flexible resilience and said it will continue a bond‑swap strategy, tightening duration while seeking higher overall yield spreads.

TSMC fell to NT$2,390 on the 19th, breaking through its quarterly moving average and dragging the market down more than 900 points. After testing the quarterly line, the stock held near the flat line, limiting the overall decline to 289.18 points or 0.61%, closing the index at 46,822.08 and defending the quarterly trend. Trading volume was NT$825.1 billion. Foreign investors kept withdrawing, net‑selling NT$76.742 billion, marking a ninth consecutive day of outflows, further cutting TSMC positions and simultaneously trimming several memory‑chip stocks.
New Taiwan dollar continues to bleed as hot money exits, closing down 1.07 ¢ at NT$32.445.
Finance Committee questioning: Is the market entering a bear phase? Peng Jin‑long says regulators will respect market mechanisms and no short‑selling limits are planned.
TSMC’s second Kumamoto fab will produce 3‑nm chips by the end of 2028, with JASM’s equipment spend topping US$23 billion.
Guotai Securities earnings highlight: securities become a “golden goose,” netting nearly NT$3.7 billion in the first three quarters and precisely swapping bonds to face U.S. rate hikes.
Foreign investors pull another NT$76.7 billion, nine days in a row, targeting TSMC and memory‑chip groups for reduction.
StarLux’s direct flights to Prague: artistic aircraft deployed on three flagship routes effectively boost passenger flow, keeping off‑peak periods lively.
First Transmission’s OTC listing: this year’s revenue hits a record high, aiming for double‑digit growth next year; reference price on the OTC market set at NT$168 as of Oct 21.
TLC‑KY’s long‑acting pain‑relief drug clears Phase‑III blind‑test, targeting U.S. launch by late 2025 or early 2026.
Shen‑Da’s subsidiary Shen‑Yun Technology returns to Taiwan for a second investment, spending NT$12.6 billion to build a new plant in Yangmei and expand production lines.
Housing: Youth‑home policies boost home‑ownership among people under 30 nationwide, raising their purchase share.
Ancheng Biotech’s “Bubble‑Dragon” drug fails to meet primary clinical endpoints; licensing timeline pushed back to the second half of 2027.

items.title: 俄羅斯確診5例猴痘病例
items.title_en: Russia Confirms 5 Monkeypox Cases
paras: 多家外媒報導，俄羅斯聖彼得堡5名因疑似感染猴痘 (Mpox) 住院的患者，已確認感染。院方表示，患者目前情況穩定，症狀為輕度至中度，正接受醫療照護。
報導援引俄羅斯塔斯社消息指出，聖彼得堡博特金傳染病醫院證實上述病例。
在確診消息公布前，俄羅斯聯邦消費者權益保護暨公益監督局位於聖彼得堡及列寧格勒州的跨區部門，已通報對這5名疑似感染者進行醫療監測。
另在莫斯科州，5名曾與疑似猴痘患者接觸的人員也被送醫觀察。
當地衛生部表示，這5人狀況良好，未出現相關臨床症狀。
截至報導發布時，莫斯科州這5名接觸者尚未獲確認感染，與聖彼得堡的5例確診病例屬不同通報。
俄羅斯衛生監管機關表示，正持續監測疫情，並備有檢測病毒所需的試劑與設備。
paras_en: Multiple foreign media outlets reported that five patients hospitalized in St. Petersburg, Russia, on suspicion of monkeypox (Mpox) infection have been confirmed positive. Hospital officials said the patients are currently stable, with mild to moderate symptoms, and are receiving medical care.
The report, citing Russian TASS news agency, noted that the Botkin Infectious Diseases Hospital in St. Petersburg confirmed the aforementioned cases.

Before the confirmation was announced, the Russian Federal Service for Consumer Rights Protection and Public Welfare Monitoring’s cross‑regional department in St. Petersburg and Leningrad Oblast had reported that the five suspected individuals were placed under medical observation.
In Moscow Oblast, five people who had been in contact with the suspected monkeypox patients were also admitted for observation.
The local health department said the five individuals are in good condition and have not shown any related clinical symptoms.
As of the time the report was released, the five contacts in Moscow Oblast had not been confirmed infected, and their cases are reported separately from the five confirmed cases in St. Petersburg.
Russian health authorities said they continue to monitor the situation and have the reagents and equipment needed to test for the virus.

1) Stock market outlook

Last Friday Hong Kong stocks rose while trading volume fell. Over the whole week, average daily turnover rose 34% month‑on‑month to HK$189.2 billion; net southbound Hong Kong‑China Stock Connect outflows were about HK$6.6 billion. The Hang Seng Index and Hang Seng Tech Index fell 0.1% and 2.1% respectively. Shenzhou International (2313), Baiji Shenzhou (6160) and Anta Sports (2020) each gained more than 7%, the biggest blue‑chip gains. Huahong Semiconductor (1347), Lenovo (992) and WuXi Biologics (2269) fell over 20%, 14% and 10%, the biggest blue‑chip losses. The Shanghai Composite and Shenzhen Component fell 2.6% and 6.6%. The S&P 500 and Nasdaq dropped 1.9% and 4.5%; NYMEX crude oil rose 10.4%; the US Dollar Index fell 0.4%; the RMB gained 0.1% versus the dollar; US 10‑year Treasury yields slipped from 5.24% to 5.10%.

China's Q3 economic growth exceeded expectations, providing a floor for both mainland and Hong Kong equities. Hong Kong stocks are undervalued, so long‑term investors are advised to modestly increase positions, and high‑dividend stocks will continue to outperform the market.
2) Summary of yesterday’s mainland and Hong Kong market conditions

items.title: 供需缺口擴大！研調機構：今年光纖現貨價料將倍速增長  資料中心需求短缺恐延續至2028年
items.title_en: Supply-Demand Gap Widens! Research Firm Says Fiber Optic Spot Prices Could Grow Tenfold This Year, Data Center Shortage May Last Until 2028
paras: 根據TrendForce最新研究，受AI資料中心、跨資料互連及高容量骨幹網路建設推升，預估2026年全球光纖供需缺口將達1.8億芯公里，供給緊縮帶動成品現貨價格年增2.8至5倍以上，電信廠商已開始調整採購模式，轉向長約布局以提前鎖定資源。
供給方面，全球光纖產能稼動率2026年升至92%，庫存由2024年的4個月降至僅1個月，部分主要廠商訂單已排至2027年第一季。光棒擴產涉及沉積設備與製程，建設期約18至24個月，短期難以有效增加供給。
至於需求，2026年全球光纖需求估計達5.77億芯公里，成長動能主要來自資料中心建設，佔比約18%至20%，2027年比重將提升至30%至35%。除大型雲端服務商外，晶片廠商及電信商也投入相關基礎建設，進一步帶動互連與骨幹需求。
價格方面，資料中心內抗彎光纖均價年增逾5倍，AI骨幹光纖漲2.8倍，電信服務主流光纖漲3.7倍。在供給持續吃緊下，Verizon已與康寧簽署多年供應協議，2027至2032年間取得逾1.29億芯公里高密度光纖，用於寬頻與AI資料中心連接。
TrendForce認為，本輪光纖緊張源自AI新增需求擴大，不同於過去電信週期。考量短期供給難增、需求穩健成長，電信與基礎設施廠商透過長約鎖定資源的趨勢將更普遍。
paras_en: According to TrendForce’s latest research, AI data centers, cross‑data interconnects and high‑capacity backbone network construction are driving demand, and the global fiber‑optic supply‑demand gap is projected to reach 180 million core‑kilometers by 2026. The tightening supply is expected to push finished‑goods spot prices up by 2.8‑to‑5‑times year‑over‑year, prompting telecom vendors to shift to long‑term contracts to lock in resources early.

On the supply side, global fiber‑optic capacity utilization is forecast to rise to 92% in 2026, with inventory falling from four months in 2024 to just one month. Some major manufacturers already have orders booked through the first quarter of 2027. Expanding fiber‑rod production requires deposition equipment and processing lines, with construction cycles of roughly 18‑24 months, making short‑term supply increases difficult.

Demand in 2026 is estimated at 577 million core‑kilometers globally, driven mainly by data‑center builds, which account for about 18‑20% of total demand and are expected to rise to 30‑35% in 2027. In addition to large cloud providers, chip makers and telecom operators are investing in related infrastructure, further boosting interconnect and backbone needs.

Price-wise, the average price of bend‑resistant fiber inside data centers has risen more than five‑fold annually, AI backbone fiber has jumped 2.8‑times, and mainstream telecom fiber has increased 3.7‑times. With supply remaining tight, Verizon has signed a multi‑year supply deal with Corning to secure over 129 million core‑kilometers of high‑density fiber for broadband and AI data‑center connections between 2027 and 2032.

TrendForce believes this round of fiber tightness stems from the surge in AI‑driven demand, which differs from past telecom cycles. Given the difficulty of expanding supply in the short term and the steady growth in demand, the trend of telecom and infrastructure firms locking in resources through long‑term contracts is expected to become more widespread.

items.title: AI熱潮退燒？避險基金急砍科技股 半導體挨刀最重
items.title_en: AI Hype Cools? Hedge Funds Slash Tech Stocks, Semiconductors Hit Hardest
paras: 高盛(GS-US)主經紀商業務部門數據顯示，避險基金近期以至少十年來最快速度削減科技股部位。在全球AI交易退燒、科技股重挫之際，基金加速降低曝險，淨槓桿也降至一年低點，反映操作轉趨保守。
根據高盛全球銀行與市場部門發布的報告，截至10月15日的五個交易日，避險基金削減科技股部位的比例，創下高盛自2016年開始統計以來最大紀錄。同期間，整體交易活動的降幅也創近三個月最大。
這波減碼正值全球科技股遭遇猛烈拋售。那斯達克100指數上周下跌5.5%，創2025年4月以來最差單周表現，AI相關交易在全球市場出現平倉潮。在高盛統計涵蓋的五個交易日內，科技類股也是MSCI世界指數中表現最差的族群。
高盛指出，避險基金對全球股票的淨賣出強度，相較過去一年資金流量分布，達到兩個標準差的水準，顯示賣壓明顯偏高。其中，資訊科技類股的淨賣出幅度遠高於其他類股，多空部位合計的縮減規模創兩個月最大；若以金額衡量，半導體股受到的衝擊最重。
不過，大幅減碼並不代表避險基金已全面撤離科技股。報告顯示，科技股淨配置仍占高盛全球主經紀商業務所追蹤投資組合的23.5%，相較過去五年仍處於第90百分位，亦即高於約九成的歷史觀察值，顯示持倉仍偏重科技股。
另一方面，衡量多頭部位超過空頭部位程度的淨槓桿，已降至48.6%，創一年低點。這意味避險基金雖仍保有可觀的科技股部位，整體承擔的方向性風險已下降，對後市的態度更加審慎。
paras_en: Goldman Sachs (GS-US) prime brokerage data shows hedge funds have recently cut tech stock positions at the fastest pace in at least a decade. As global AI trading cools and tech stocks tumble, funds are accelerating exposure reductions, with net leverage falling to a one‑year low, reflecting a more conservative stance.

According to a report from Goldman Sachs Global Banking & Markets, over the five trading days ending October 15, the proportion of tech stock reductions by hedge funds hit the highest level recorded since Goldman began tracking the metric in 2016. During the same period, overall trading activity also fell by the largest margin in nearly three months.

This wave of trimming comes as global tech stocks face a fierce sell‑off. The Nasdaq‑100 fell 5.5% last week, marking its worst weekly performance since April 2025, and AI‑related trades have been liquidated worldwide. In the five‑day window covered by Goldman, tech stocks were the worst‑performing sector in the MSCI World Index.

Goldman notes that hedge funds’ net selling intensity in global equities reached two standard deviations above the distribution of fund flows over the past year, indicating markedly high selling pressure. Information technology stocks saw net sell volumes far exceeding other sectors, with the combined long‑short position reduction hitting a two‑month maximum; in dollar terms, semiconductor stocks bore the brunt of the impact.

However, the sizable cuts do not mean hedge funds have fully exited tech stocks. The report shows that net tech exposure still accounts for 23.5% of the portfolios tracked by Goldman’s global prime brokerage, placing it in the 90th percentile over the past five years—about nine‑tenths above historical averages—indicating a continued bias toward tech holdings.

Meanwhile, net leverage, which measures long positions relative to short positions, has fallen to 48.6%, a one‑year low. This suggests that while hedge funds still hold substantial tech positions, their overall directional risk exposure has decreased, reflecting a more cautious outlook for the market ahead.

items.title: AI燒錢還有看不見的帳？標普警告科技巨頭負債恐高於已知規模
items.title_en: S&P Warns Tech Giants' AI Debt May Exceed Known Scale
paras: 標普全球警告，全球大型科技公司的AI相關債務與潛在負債，可能高於目前外界掌握的規模。隨著業者透過相互連結的融資安排支撐資料中心建設，部分財務承擔未必已充分反映在公開資訊中。不過，標普目前仍認為，沒有必要因此調整相關企業的信用評等。
近幾周，AI基礎設施供應商與新型雲端業者發行的債券持續承壓，包括獲輝達(NVDA-US)支持的CoreWeave(CRWV-US)。市場擔憂，這些企業為擴張算力而大舉借貸，可能帶來過高的財務風險。
標普全球數位基礎設施主管哈比布(Mark Habib)在倫敦一場圓桌會議上表示，對超大規模雲端業者而言，信用評等面臨的最大風險，仍是預期獲利最終未能實現。
他也特別點出「相互連結的融資結構」：大型科技公司可能實質上為巨額資料中心建設，或規模較小的AI公司提供擔保，使其財務風險不只限於直接借款。
哈比布表示：「可以合理假設，還有更多我們尚未看到的債務。」如果相關負債未被揭露，或標普未參與可能產生這些責任的交易評等，就可能無法掌握完整情況。
標普預估，美國六大超大規模雲端業者，包括亞馬遜(AMZN-US)、微軟(MSFT-US)、Alphabet(GOOGL-US)、甲骨文(ORCL-US)、Meta(META-US)與SpaceX(SPCX-US)，2025年至2030年間投入資料中心及其他AI相關資本支出的金額，將超過7兆美元，自由現金流則預料至少到明年仍為負值。
對於這類循環融資安排可能為企業資產負債表增加多少債務，哈比布表示，目前尚無估計數字，但標普正嘗試從整體角度評估相關風險。
標普今年7月已因擔憂甲骨文的AI支出，以及其「獲利路徑仍不明確」，將該公司信用評等調降至BBB-，也就是投資等級的最低一級。
近期AI相關債券遭到拋售，也引發市場是否已認為其風險高於信用評等所反映程度的疑問。對此，哈比布表示，目前標普並不認為兩者出現重大落差，足以迫使其調整評等，並強調信用評等著眼於較長期的表現。
不過，若愈來愈明確的跡象顯示，企業支出規模已無法持續，標普便可能改變看法。哈比布指出，業者進一步擴大投資，或市場競爭過於激烈、影響營收前景，都可能成為觸發重新評估的因素。
paras_en: S&P Global warns that AI‑related debt and potential liabilities of large global tech companies could be larger than currently understood, as firms use interconnected financing arrangements to support data‑center construction, with some financial commitments not fully reflected in public information. However, S&P still sees no need to adjust the credit ratings of the affected companies.

In recent weeks, bonds issued by AI infrastructure providers and new‑wave cloud operators have remained under pressure, including CoreWeave (CRWV‑US) backed by Nvidia (NVDA‑US). The market worries that these firms are borrowing heavily to expand compute capacity, which could create excessive financial risk.

Mark Habib, head of digital infrastructure at S&P Global, told a round‑table in London that for ultra‑large cloud providers the biggest rating risk remains the possibility that expected profits ultimately fail to materialise.

He highlighted the “interconnected financing structure”: large tech firms may effectively guarantee massive data‑center builds or smaller AI companies, extending financial risk beyond direct borrowing.

Habib said, “It is reasonable to assume there is more debt we have not yet seen.” If such liabilities are undisclosed, or S&P is not involved in rating the transactions that could generate them, the full picture may be missed.

S&P estimates that the six biggest U.S. ultra‑large cloud providers—Amazon (AMZN‑US), Microsoft (MSFT‑US), Alphabet (GOOGL‑US), Oracle (ORCL‑US), Meta (META‑US) and SpaceX (SPCX‑US)—will spend over $7 trillion on data‑center and other AI‑related capital expenditures between 2025 and 2030, with free cash flow expected to remain negative at least through next year.

Regarding how much such circular financing arrangements could add to corporate balance sheets, Habib said there is currently no estimate, but S&P is trying to assess the risk from a holistic perspective.
In July this year S&P downgraded Oracle to BBB‑ after concerns over its AI spending and an “unclear profit pathway,” placing it at the lowest tier of investment‑grade ratings.

Recent sell‑offs of AI‑linked bonds have raised questions about whether the market now views the risk as higher than the credit ratings suggest. Habib responded that S&P does not see a material gap sufficient to trigger a rating change and stressed that ratings focus on longer‑term performance.

However, if increasingly clear signs emerge that corporate spending levels are unsustainable, S&P may change its view. Habib noted that further investment expansion, overly intense market competition, or weakened revenue outlooks could all trigger a reassessment.

items.title: Mac能觸控、iPad mini換OLED？蘋果月底發表會亮點一次看
items.title_en: Mac Touchscreen, iPad mini Switching to OLED? Apple Event Highlights at Month-End
paras: 蘋果(AAPL-US)將於10月28日舉行「Pro and tell」發表會，繼本月智慧家庭新品登場後，再度更新產品陣容。這次焦點預料將轉向Mac與iPad，包括外界期待已久的OLED觸控版MacBook Pro、新款iPad mini，以及搭載M6晶片的MacBook Pro與iMac。
蘋果已向受邀者發送活動邀請，全球行銷資深副總裁喬斯維亞克(Greg Joswiak)也在社群平台X發布活動標誌，預告下周登場。目前各款新品規格仍以市場傳聞為主，預定11月6日進行的零售門市布置更新，則被視為新品可能於當天開賣的線索。
今年秋季蘋果新品推出節奏格外密集，8月底先更新Mac mini與Mac Studio，9月發表iPhone、Apple Watch與AirPods新品，10月再推出HomeView、HomePod mini 2及新版Apple TV 4K。相較之下，iPad與筆電產品尚未在這波秋季更新中登場，因而成為月底發表會的關注重點。

iPad mini傳升級OLED 螢幕與晶片成改款焦點

第八代iPad mini預料將以螢幕升級為主要賣點。市場傳聞指出，新機可能採用8.4吋LTPS混合式OLED面板，改善亮度、色彩表現，讓iPad mini也加入OLED產品行列，但規格未必與iPad Pro相同。
至於是否支援ProMotion高更新率技術，目前仍有不同說法，尚不能確定。法國監管網站近期出現與iPad mini相關的裝置識別資訊，則被視為新品接近推出的另一項跡象。
處理器方面，A20是目前傳聞較看好的選項，新機也可能導入蘋果自研的無線連網與數據機晶片。其他傳聞包括調整FaceTime相機位置，以及採用新式振動發聲揚聲器，以改善防水表現。

MacBook Pro傳迎觸控 OLED之外也可能減重

OLED MacBook Pro是另一項重頭戲。這款產品原先被預期於2027年初推出，如今市場認為，可能提前至今年10月發表、11月上市。
OLED螢幕可帶來更鮮明的色彩與更高對比度，也具有省電潛力。若同時導入觸控功能，將成為首款支援觸控操作的MacBook，讓蘋果加入已有多款觸控產品的筆電市場。
10月5日，有人在macOS 27.2開發者測試版中發現，多款應用程式出現新增觸控辨識能力的相關線索，被解讀為蘋果正為觸控Mac做準備，但仍不等於官方確認產品規格。
機身設計方面，10月4日的報導稱，蘋果可能透過縮小零組件尺寸、採用更輕的設計，明顯降低新機重量。不過，10月8日另一篇報導則修正了先前有關機身將變薄的說法，因此「減重」與「變薄」仍須分開看待。

M6入門款與iMac料偏重效能 其他新品可能等到明年

除了OLED觸控機型，蘋果也可能推出搭載M6晶片的入門款MacBook Pro，延續8月底M6 Mac mini的更新腳步。
據傳，這款入門機型仍會保留支援ProMotion的mini LED螢幕，六揚聲器音響系統、連接埠與機身設計也與現行版本相同，主要升級將集中在M6晶片帶來的效能提升，與OLED觸控款有所區隔。
24吋iMac預料也採取類似策略，換上M6晶片，但維持現有外觀與螢幕。雖然市場曾傳出iMac未來可能採用OLED，這次更新仍不預期出現這項變化。
至於MacBook Air、MacBook Neo、iPhone Air 2、iPhone 18、iPhone 18e，以及iPad Air、iPad Pro與入門款iPad等產品，相關更新傳聞目前較指向2027年初，並非這次月底活動的主要預期名單。
paras_en: Apple (AAPL-US) will hold a "Pro and tell" event on October 28, updating its product lineup after this month’s smart‑home releases. The focus is expected to shift to Macs and iPads, including the long‑awaited OLED touchscreen MacBook Pro, a new iPad mini, and MacBook Pro and iMac models powered by the M6 chip.

Apple has sent invitations to attendees, and senior vice president of worldwide marketing Greg Joswiak posted the event logo on X, teasing the launch next week. Specifications for the new products remain based on market rumors, and the retail‑store refresh slated for November 6 is seen as a clue that the devices could go on sale that day.

Apple’s autumn product rollout this year is unusually dense: late August saw updates to the Mac mini and Mac Studio, September brought new iPhone, Apple Watch and AirPods models, and October introduced HomeView, HomePod mini 2 and a new Apple TV 4K. In contrast, iPad and laptop products have not appeared in this wave, making them the focal point of the month‑end event.

The iPad mini is expected to be refreshed mainly with a screen upgrade. Rumors suggest the new device could use an 8.4‑inch LTPS hybrid OLED panel, improving brightness and colour performance and adding the iPad mini to Apple’s OLED lineup, though its specs may not match those of the iPad Pro.

Whether it will support ProMotion’s high refresh rate is still debated, and no confirmation exists yet. A French regulatory site recently displayed device identification info related to the iPad mini, which is taken as another sign that the product is nearing launch.

On the processor side, the A20 is the most favoured rumor, and the new iPad mini may also incorporate Apple‑designed wireless and modem chips. Other rumors include moving the FaceTime camera location and using a new vibration‑driven speaker to improve water resistance.
The OLED MacBook Pro is another headline act. Originally expected in early 2027, the market now thinks it could be announced in October and ship in November, potentially ahead of schedule.

An OLED display would deliver more vivid colours, higher contrast and power‑saving benefits. If combined with touch capability, it would become the first touchscreen‑enabled MacBook, bringing Apple into the laptop market that already hosts several touchscreen devices.

On October 5, a developer build of macOS 27.2 showed multiple apps with added touch‑recognition hints, interpreted as Apple preparing a touchscreen Mac, though this does not constitute official confirmation of product specs.

Regarding chassis design, a report on October 4 said Apple might shrink component sizes and use lighter materials to noticeably reduce the new model’s weight. However, a follow‑up report on October 8 corrected earlier claims about the device becoming thinner, so weight reduction and thinness should be considered separately.
Beyond the OLED touchscreen variant, Apple may also launch an entry‑level MacBook Pro with the M6 chip, continuing the M6 Mac mini update introduced at the end of August.

According to rumors, this entry model would retain a ProMotion‑compatible mini‑LED display, a six‑speaker audio system, ports and chassis design identical to the current version, with the main upgrade being the performance boost from the M6 chip, distinguishing it from the OLED touchscreen version.

The 24‑inch iMac is also expected to follow a similar strategy, swapping in the M6 chip while keeping its existing look and screen. Although there were whispers that future iMacs might adopt OLED, this refresh is not expected to bring that change.

As for the MacBook Air, MacBook Neo, iPhone Air 2, iPhone 18, iPhone 18e, as well as iPad Air, iPad Pro and entry‑level iPad, related rumors point to early 2027 releases and are not part of the primary expectations for this month‑end event.

items.title: Mac終於能用手點？蘋果10月28日發表會 傳推首款觸控筆電
items.title_en: Apple to Unveil First Touchscreen MacBook Pro at October 28 Event
paras: 蘋果(AAPL-US)周一(19日)宣布，將於10月28日在洛杉磯舉行產品發表會，主題為「Pro and tell」。據《彭博》報導，蘋果計畫在活動中推出首款觸控螢幕MacBook Pro，並更新多款Mac與iPad產品，為多年來堅持區隔Mac與iPad使用體驗的策略帶來重大轉變。
新款觸控MacBook Pro預計搭載OLED螢幕，提供更清晰的顯示效果，並導入類似iPhone的動態島(Dynamic Island)介面。觸控、OLED與動態島都將首次出現在Mac產品上。
不過，新機預計仍採用M5 Pro與M5 Max晶片，與今年3月推出的現行MacBook Pro相同，這次改款重點將落在螢幕與操作介面。
《彭博》先前報導，蘋果也將推出搭載M6晶片的入門款MacBook Pro、更新版iMac，以及螢幕更清晰的新版iPad mini。這意味同場亮相的MacBook Pro產品，預計將分別採用M6與M5 Pro、M5 Max晶片。
蘋果近幾周已密集發表新品，包括HomeView、HomePod mini 2與更新版Apple TV機上盒；旗下首款摺疊iPhone「iPhone Duo」則將於本周五開賣，接續由Mac與iPad新品登場。
《彭博》周日另報導，蘋果零售門市正準備於11月6日周五開始銷售新品，但各款產品的確切上市安排，仍待蘋果正式公布。
觸控MacBook Pro將是這波新品的重要焦點。蘋果過去多年強調，不會將iPad與Mac的使用體驗結合，如今計畫把觸控操作與iPhone上的動態島帶進Mac，顯示其筆電產品設計方向出現明顯轉變。
paras_en: Apple (AAPL-US) announced on Monday (the 19th) that it will hold a product launch event in Los Angeles on October 28, themed “Pro and tell.” Bloomberg reports that Apple plans to debut its first touchscreen MacBook Pro at the event and refresh a range of Mac and iPad products, marking a major shift in its long‑standing strategy of keeping Mac and iPad experiences separate.

The new touchscreen MacBook Pro is expected to feature an OLED display for sharper visuals and will incorporate a Dynamic Island interface similar to that on the iPhone. Touch input, OLED and Dynamic Island will appear on a Mac product for the first time.

However, the new model is still expected to use the M5 Pro and M5 Max chips, the same as the current MacBook Pro launched in March this year, with the redesign focusing on the screen and user interface.

Bloomberg previously reported that Apple will also launch an entry‑level MacBook Pro with an M6 chip, an updated iMac, and a new iPad mini with a clearer display. This suggests that the MacBook Pro models unveiled at the same event will likely come with M6 as well as M5 Pro and M5 Max processors.

In recent weeks Apple has been rolling out new products, including HomeView, a second‑generation HomePod mini and an updated Apple TV set‑top box; its first foldable iPhone, the “iPhone Duo,” is slated to go on sale this Friday, following the Mac and iPad announcements.

Bloomberg reported on Sunday that Apple’s retail stores are preparing to start selling the new products on Friday, November 6, though the exact launch schedule for each item remains to be confirmed by Apple.

The touchscreen MacBook Pro will be a key focus of this product wave. After years of emphasizing that iPad and Mac experiences would remain separate, Apple now plans to bring touch interaction and the iPhone’s Dynamic Island to the Mac, indicating a clear shift in its laptop design direction.

paras:
台股盤前要聞 

1.台北金融市場19日「股匯雙殺」再現，受到美股震盪及國際避險情緒升溫影響，外資持續大舉撤資，三大法人合計賣超台股899.54億元，加權指數一度重挫941點，台積電 (2330-TW) (TSM-US) 等權值股尾盤急拉，終場下跌289.18點，收在46822.08點。匯市在資金大量淨匯出壓力下，新台幣兌美元匯率開低走低，盤中一度觸及32.572元低點，終場重貶1.07角收在32.445元，兩大外匯市場爆出38.53億美元的大量。
2.近期台股波動加劇，引發市場對「熊市」的擔憂，19日立法院財政委員會高度關注政府監理工具與當沖降稅政策。金管會主委彭金隆強調，監理機關首重尊重市場機制，目前交易秩序仍屬理性，暫無實施限空或禁空等人工干預措施；針對 2027 年底到期的當沖降稅優惠，金管會規劃於明年 2、3 月召開公聽會廣徵各界意見，再行定奪。
3.台積電(2330-TW)及其日本子公司JASM提出的熊本二廠生產計畫變更申請，獲日本政府核准，將改為生產3奈米製程邏輯晶片，隨著計劃的調整，JASM設備投資總額預計將超過230億美元。
4.國票金控(2889-TW)19日召開第三季法說會，前 3 季累計稅後純益達 36.92 億元、年增 116.29%，EPS 達 1.01 元，其中國票證券獲利大增 3 倍創歷史新高。面對美國聯準會(Fed)通膨風險升高、貨幣政策偏緊且年底仍具升息空間的環境，經營團隊展現靈活韌性，未來將持續執行債券置換策略，在控制存續期間的前提下，進一步提高整體養券利差。
5.台積電19日一度跌至2390元，摜破季線關卡，拖累大盤一度跌逾900點，回測季線，不過在台積電力守平盤下，跌幅收斂終場跌289.18點或0.61%，收46822.08點，守住季線，成交量8251.01億元。外資今天繼續提款，賣超767.42億元，連9賣，續砍台積電，並同步減碼多檔記憶體。

paras_en: Taiwan’s pre‑market briefing notes that on the 19th the Taipei financial market saw a repeat “stock‑and‑currency double‑kill.” Driven by volatile U.S. equities and heightened global safe‑haven sentiment, foreign investors kept pulling out large sums, with the three major institutional groups net‑selling NT$89.954 billion of Taiwanese stocks. The weighted index plunged as much as 941 points before ending down 289.18 points at 46,822.08. Major chips such as TSMC (2330‑TW, TSM‑US) rallied sharply at the close but still finished lower. In the foreign‑exchange market, heavy net outflows pressured the New Taiwan dollar, which opened lower and fell to a intraday low of NT$32.572 per US$, closing down 1.07 ¢ at NT$32.445. Two major FX markets saw a combined outflow of US$3.853 billion.

Recent volatility in Taiwan’s equity market has sparked worries of a bear market. On the 19th the Legislative Yuan’s Finance Committee closely examined the government’s supervisory tools and the tax‑break policy for day‑trading. Financial Supervisory Commission (FSC) Chairman Peng Jin‑long stressed that regulators must first respect market mechanisms; trading remains orderly and rational, and there are currently no plans to impose short‑selling caps or bans. Regarding the day‑trading tax‑reduction incentive that expires at the end of 2027, the FSC will hold public hearings in February‑March next year to gather stakeholder input before making a decision.

TSMC (2330‑TW) and its Japanese subsidiary JASM have received approval from the Japanese government to amend the production plan for the second Kumamoto fab. The facility will now produce 3‑nanometer logic chips, and the revised plan lifts the total equipment investment to exceed US$23 billion.

Guotai Securities Holding (2889‑TW) held its Q3 earnings briefing on the 19th. Cumulative net profit after tax for the first three quarters reached NT$3.692 billion, up 116.29% year‑on‑year, with EPS of NT$1.01. Guotai Securities’ profit tripled to a historic high. Facing higher inflation risk from the U.S. Federal Reserve, tighter monetary policy and still‑available rate‑hike room at year‑end, management highlighted its flexible resilience and said it will continue a bond‑swap strategy, tightening duration while seeking higher overall yield spreads.

TSMC fell to NT$2,390 on the 19th, breaking through its quarterly moving average and dragging the market down more than 900 points. After testing the quarterly line, the stock held near the flat line, limiting the overall decline to 289.18 points or 0.61%, closing the index at 46,822.08 and defending the quarterly trend. Trading volume was NT$825.1 billion. Foreign investors kept withdrawing, net‑selling NT$76.742 billion, marking a ninth consecutive day of outflows, further cutting TSMC positions and simultaneously trimming several memory‑chip stocks.
New Taiwan dollar continues to bleed as hot money exits, closing down 1.07 ¢ at NT$32.445.
Finance Committee questioning: Is the market entering a bear phase? Peng Jin‑long says regulators will respect market mechanisms and no short‑selling limits are planned.

Foreign investors pull another NT$76.7 billion, nine days in a row, targeting TSMC and memory‑chip groups for reduction.

items.title: 台玻T-glass獲認證、高階玻纖布持續出貨 法人給予投資建議點讚
items.title_en: Taiwan Glass T‑glass Certified, High‑End Fiberglass Cloth Continues Shipping; Institutional Investors Praise Investment Recommendation
paras: 玻陶廠台玻(1802-TW)受惠LOW DK高階玻纖布持續出貨，加上T-glass已通過國內外廠商認證，上(9)月營收月增8.1%、年增34.1%，優於市場預期。法人指出，在產品挹注營收、毛利率成長動能下，對台玻未來營運狀況樂觀，也給予「買進」評等。
台玻近年持續從傳產強化轉型腳步，受惠於AI產業需求持續蓬勃發展，逐步轉型為電子材料廠，布局玻纖布等相關產品，包括台玻T-glass目前已通過國內外廠商認證，加上Low Dk(低介電)系列高階玻纖布持續出貨下，持續挹注營收增長，今(2026)年累計前9月合併營收已年增達18.6%。
法人報告指出，台玻受惠AI伺服器與高速運算帶動材料升級，低介電、低熱膨脹係數玻纖布需求增溫，擴充高階產能，包括日廠Nittobo也再次強調T-glass需求已非當前公司擴產速度所能消化，顯示產品需求強勁，若未來國內外廠商持續調漲玻纖布產品報價，台玻有望受惠漲價效應挹注業績。
台玻董事長林伯豐今年也表示，今年度持續投入20億元擴充產線，確保 Low DK及Low CTE玻纖布供應能力，目前供需仍相當吃緊狀況下，預估產品供不應求情況將延續至明(2027)年。
台玻今年在高階玻纖布產線規劃上，也從4條擴增至12條，力拚出貨產能因應客戶需求。
分析師今日則表示，台玻的LOW DK玻纖布已通過認證，包括AI大廠輝達(NVDA-US)產品，也需要高階玻纖布的供應料件，目前根據高階玻纖布出貨量觀察，台玻占市場約40%左右，高階產品經營客戶認證下，與以往景氣循環股的台玻產品不同，加上法人估明年業績有望增長下，長線看好台玻股價發展。
paras_en: Glass‑ceramic manufacturer Taiwan Glass (1802‑TW) benefited from continued shipments of its low‑dielectric (LOW DK) high‑end fiberglass cloth, and its T‑glass has passed certifications from both domestic and overseas manufacturers. In September, revenue rose 8.1% month‑over‑month and 34.1% year‑over‑year, beating market expectations. Institutions noted that product‑driven revenue and margin growth give a positive outlook for Taiwan Glass’s future operations and assigned a “Buy” rating.

In recent years Taiwan Glass has been strengthening its transformation from a traditional manufacturer toward an electronic‑materials company, driven by the booming AI industry. It has been expanding into products such as fiberglass cloth. Its T‑glass has now cleared certifications from domestic and foreign customers, and the ongoing shipments of its low‑dielectric (Low Dk) high‑end fiberglass cloth continue to feed revenue growth. For the first nine months of 2026, consolidated revenue was up 18.6% year‑over‑year.

The institutional report points out that Taiwan Glass is benefiting from AI servers and high‑speed computing that are prompting material upgrades. Demand for low‑dielectric, low‑coefficient‑of‑thermal‑expansion (Low CTE) fiberglass cloth is rising, prompting expansion of high‑end capacity. Even Japanese partner Nittobo reiterated that T‑glass demand now exceeds the company’s current expansion speed, indicating strong product demand. If domestic and overseas customers keep raising fiberglass‑cloth prices, Taiwan Glass could capture the price‑increase effect in its earnings.

Chairman Lin Bo‑feng said the company will invest NT$20 billion this year to expand production lines, ensuring supply capacity for Low DK and Low CTE fiberglass cloth. With supply still tight, the company expects the shortage to persist into 2027.
This year Taiwan Glass expanded its high‑end fiberglass‑cloth production lines from four to twelve, striving to increase shipping capacity to meet customer demand.

Analysts noted today that Taiwan Glass’s LOW DK fiberglass cloth has earned certifications, including for AI giant NVIDIA’s (NVDA‑US) products, which also require high‑end fiberglass cloth components. Based on shipment data, Taiwan Glass now holds roughly 40% of the high‑end market. Unlike its traditional cyclical‑stock profile, the certified high‑end product line and institutional expectations of earnings growth next year lead analysts to be bullish on the long‑term price development of Taiwan Glass’s stock.

items.title: 科普環島列車啟程 國科會：AI時代更需培育科研新秀
items.title_en: Science Outreach Island Train Departs; Academia Sinica: AI Era Calls for Nurturing New Research Talent
paras: 「2026台灣科普環島列車」今(19)日起從台北車站出發，展開為期6天的全台科學之旅。國科會主委吳誠文表示，台灣要成為科技強國，科研發展與人才培育是重要基礎，國科會與數發部推動AI基本法中，很重要的原則就是人類自主，AI在某些特定應用裡能力會超越人類，但終究僅是一個工具，人類自主最重要的就是從小認識科學。
今年科普列車以「車門一開，未來展開」為主題，將半導體、太空、智慧醫療等前瞻領域導入車廂體驗，目的就是要在課堂之外激發年輕世代的好奇心與創造力，為國家永續發展蓄積最堅實的科研新血。
吳誠文表示，國科會期盼持續推動科普活動，目前很多人憂慮AI快速發展會不會最後對人類造成傷害？AI Doom(末日論)是不是真的存在？但國科會與數發部推動AI基本法裡面一個很重要的原則就是人類自主，AI在某些特定應用裡，能力會超越人類，但它僅是人類使用的一個工具，人類必須善用這個工具，從設計工具到使用工具，都要確保是在人類可以控制的範圍之下。
吳誠文說，國科會協助國家推動科普教育，讓民眾可以認同科學的基本原理，觸發大家的探索心、好奇心，不斷努力促進科技發展，才能真正掌控自己的未來，發展出更好的工具來協助我們，而民間企業未來能好好善用科技實力，不能缺少青出於藍的年輕人進到科技領域。
台鐵公司董事長鄭光遠也說，台鐵很榮幸能與國科會攜手合作，以鐵道路網作為科學教育推廣的平台，未來也將持續以安全、可靠的運輸服務，支持更多教育推廣活動。

國科會指出，今年科普環島列車打造8節「移動實驗室」主題車廂，由數發部、台灣默克集團、友達永續基金會、瑞健醫療、上銀公司(2049-TW)、國研院海洋科技研究中心與國家地震工程研究中心、國家太空中心、世界(5347-TW)先進積體電路公司、Tokyo Electron Taiwan及財育秀教育基金會等單位共同規劃，內容橫跨海洋科技、太空探索、防震知識、綠色永續、智慧醫療、通訊技術、尖端材料及食品科學等領域。
paras_en: The "2026 Taiwan Science Outreach Island Train" set off from Taipei Station today (19th) for a six‑day nationwide scientific tour. Academia Sinica Council Chair Wu Cheng‑wen said that for Taiwan to become a technology powerhouse, research development and talent cultivation are essential foundations. The council, together with the Ministry of Digital Affairs, is promoting an AI Basic Law that emphasizes human autonomy: while AI may surpass humans in certain specific applications, it remains merely a tool, and fostering scientific awareness from a young age is paramount.

This year’s outreach train, themed “Open the Door, Unfold the Future,” brings forward‑looking fields such as semiconductors, space and smart healthcare into the train cars, aiming to spark curiosity and creativity among the younger generation beyond the classroom and to build a solid pipeline of new researchers for the nation’s sustainable development.

Wu Cheng‑wen noted that the council hopes to keep advancing science outreach. Many worry whether rapid AI development could ultimately harm humanity—does an AI “doom” really exist? The AI Basic Law’s key principle is human autonomy: AI may out‑perform humans in certain tasks, but it is only a tool for human use. Humans must employ it wisely, ensuring that both its design and deployment stay within controllable limits.

Wu added that the council assists the nation in promoting science education so the public can appreciate basic scientific principles, ignite exploration and curiosity, and continuously drive technological progress. Only then can we truly control our future, develop better tools to aid us, and ensure private enterprises can leverage technological strength with a new generation of talent entering the tech sector.

Taiwan Railways Administration Chairman Cheng Kuang‑yuan also expressed pride in collaborating with Academia Sinica, using the rail network as a platform for science education outreach. He said the railway will continue to support more educational activities with safe, reliable transport services.

The council highlighted that this year’s island train features eight “mobile laboratory” themed cars, jointly planned by the Ministry of Digital Affairs, Taiwan Merck Group, AU Optronics Sustainable Foundation, Ruijian Medical, Hiwin Technologies (2049‑TW), National Academy of Marine Technology, National Center for Earthquake Engineering Research, National Space Center, World (5347‑TW) Advanced Integrated Circuit Company, Tokyo Electron Taiwan, and the Caixiu Education Foundation. The content spans marine technology, space exploration, seismic safety, green sustainability, smart healthcare, communications, advanced materials, and food science.

items.title: 中保旗下國雲智慧停車 登韓國首亮相AI「智慧停車管理數據中心」
items.title_en: China Insurance's Guoyun Smart Parking Debuts AI "Smart Parking Management Data Center" at Korea's First International Showcase
paras: 中保科技(9917-TW)集團旗下的「國雲智慧停車」創新再度登上國際舞台。於南韓江陵隆重舉行的智慧交通界最高盛會「2026江陵ITS世界大會（ITS World Congress）」上，由中保科技董事長林建涵、國雲智慧停車董事長張奕春等今(19）日宣布，發表全台首創「智慧停車管理數據中心」登上國際級展會盛大展出。
中保旗下國雲智慧停車並在此地成功向全球展現台灣在路邊智慧停車、AIoT 軟硬體整合與數據治理上的頂尖實力，交通部政務次長陳彥伯也親自來到韓國江陵ITS世界大會現場參訪。
中保科技董事長林建涵指出，國雲智慧停車深耕台灣路邊停車管理近20年，今(2026)年首度發表「智慧停車管理數據中心」，核心優勢在於「軟硬體的高度整合與升級」。國雲針對原本既有的路邊智慧停車硬體設備（如智慧地磁、高/中/低位影像辨識柱及車牌辨識系統等），全面導入後台智慧管理中心與 AI 運算軟體平台，打破以往硬體設備分散獨立運作的限制。
國雲智慧停車董事長張奕春分析，透過軟硬體的深度結合，管理中心串聯了現場設備、即時影像監控與第一線運維人員，實時將城市各角落的停車數據匯入中心，形成「設備連線 × 數據監控 × 資料整合」的協同運作機制。透過巨型監控牆與可視化數據儀表板，管理者能一目瞭然掌握開單量、即時周轉率、繳費進度與催繳動態，將既有硬體收集到的現場資訊，真正轉化為可追蹤、可執行的智慧治理決策。
此外，平台具備深入的路段壓力分析功能，能精準判讀高需求熱點與尖峰壓力，並結合申訴與服務品質指標，協助市府機關彈性調整費率、科學化配置裝卸車格與調度巡查人力，達到「用數據看見治理重點、提升市民滿意度」的目標。

中保科技目前這套「智慧停車管理數據中心」先建置於台中，也是落實公私協力邁向智慧治理，打造低碳永續城市關鍵布局。國雲智慧停車總經理古昌灝分析，停車位不只是靜止的設施，更是反映城市脈動的感知節點。透過「智慧停車管理數據中心」軟硬兼備的完整系統，不僅為台灣打造出高效率、具財務可行性的智慧停車示範場域，更透過無紙化開單與智慧導引尋車，大幅降低車輛繞行產生的碳排放。未來，中保科技與國雲智慧停車將持續攜手各縣市政府，以科技賦能城市管理，共同邁向更智慧、更永續的低碳城市。
paras_en: China Insurance Technology (9917-TW) Group's "Guoyun Smart Parking" innovation once again takes the international stage. At South Korea's Gangneung, the premier smart transportation event "2026 Gangneung ITS World Congress" was held, where China Insurance Technology Chairman Lin Jianhan and Guoyun Smart Parking Chairman Zhang Yichun announced today (the 19th) the launch of Taiwan’s first "Smart Parking Management Data Center," showcased at the international exhibition.

Guoyun Smart Parking, a subsidiary of China Insurance, successfully demonstrated Taiwan’s leading capabilities in roadside smart parking, AIoT hardware‑software integration, and data governance to a global audience, with Ministry of Transportation Deputy Minister Chen Yanbo personally visiting the Gangneung ITS World Congress site in Korea.

Chairman Lin Jianhan noted that Guoyun Smart Parking has been deep‑rooted in Taiwan’s roadside parking management for nearly 20 years, and this 2026 debut of the "Smart Parking Management Data Center" highlights its core advantage of highly integrated and upgraded hardware and software. Guoyun has taken existing roadside smart parking hardware—such as smart magnetic sensors, high/medium/low‑level imaging recognition poles, and license‑plate recognition systems—and fully incorporated them into a back‑office intelligent management center and AI computing platform, breaking the previous limitation of fragmented, standalone hardware operation.

Chairman Zhang Yichun explained that the deep hardware‑software convergence allows the management center to link on‑site equipment, real‑time video monitoring, and frontline operations staff, feeding parking data from across the city into the center. This creates a collaborative mechanism of "device connectivity × data monitoring × data integration." With a giant monitoring wall and visual dashboards, managers can instantly see ticket issuance volume, real‑time turnover rates, payment progress, and collection dynamics, turning raw hardware‑collected information into traceable, actionable smart‑governance decisions.

The platform also features advanced road‑segment pressure analysis, accurately identifying high‑demand hotspots and peak stress points. Coupled with complaint and service‑quality metrics, it helps municipal authorities flexibly adjust rates, scientifically allocate loading‑zone slots, and schedule patrol personnel, achieving the goal of "using data to highlight governance priorities and boost citizen satisfaction."

Currently, China Insurance has first built this "Smart Parking Management Data Center" in Taichung, embodying public‑private cooperation toward smart governance and a low‑carbon sustainable city layout. General Manager Gu Changhao of Guoyun Smart Parking said parking spaces are more than static facilities; they are sensory nodes reflecting urban pulse. The fully integrated hardware‑software system not only creates a high‑efficiency, financially viable smart‑parking demonstration for Taiwan, but also, through paperless ticketing and intelligent vehicle‑guidance, dramatically cuts vehicle circling emissions. Going forward, China Insurance and Guoyun Smart Parking will continue partnering with municipal governments, using technology to empower city management and jointly advance toward smarter, more sustainable low‑carbon cities.
