items.title: 全球獨家主辦行 滙豐協助華碩完成首筆20億美元海外聯貸
items.title_en: Global Lead Arranger HSBC Helps Asus Complete First $2 Billion Overseas Syndicated Loan
paras: 滙豐銀行近期透過跨市場團隊合作，成功協助華碩在新加坡的全資子公司ASUS Global Pte. Ltd.完成總額 20 億美元的聯貸融資。本案是華碩成立以來首度在海外資本市場進行聯貸，深具指標性意義。本次融資將提升華碩集團的流動性與財務彈性，支持其營運成長及擴張計畫。
本次交易獲得參貸銀行的熱烈支持，原本預計募集10億美元，在金融同業踴躍參貸下，最終簽約金額上調至20億美元。此結果充分反映市場對華碩業務實力及長期前景的信心，也展現滙豐協助首次進行聯貸籌資的客戶完成大規模融資的能力。滙豐銀行於本交易中擔任獨家協調行、統籌主辦行及簿記行，和融資代理行，彰顯滙豐透過亞太區團隊合作，將市場需求轉化為客戶融資成果的實力。
滙豐(台灣)商業銀行總經理陳志堅表示：「我們很榮幸協助華碩完成其首筆20億美元海外聯貸融資。這項交易展現滙豐將深厚的台灣市場經驗、全球網絡及跨境融資能力相結合，為客戶提供具規模的全方位融資方案。隨著華碩拓展人工智慧伺服器及資料中心解決方案等新領域，我們期待持續支持其業務發展及全球布局。」

華碩電腦財務長暨發言人吳長榮表示：「全球正邁入 AI 超級週期，AI應用的需求快速攀升。華碩深耕品牌價值、凝聚創新研發能量、並與全球銷售通路與平台夥伴緊密合作，將持續完善涵蓋Cloud AI、Edge AI與Physical AI的全方位AI布局，這次聯貸獲得國際銀行團的支持，將為我們深化AI應用、拓展全球布局挹注穩健動能。在Ubiquitous AI, Incredible Possibilities的策略下，華碩將致力於落實從雲端至邊緣的 AI 應用，滿足全球企業用戶與個人用戶的多元需求。」
滙豐亞太區銀團貸款組主管邵熙 (Ashish Sharma)表示：「這項交易凝聚了滙豐台灣、新加坡及香港團隊的專業力量。透過團隊對當地市場的深入了解、豐富的聯貸融資經驗及緊密合作，我們為華碩量身打造並順利執行其首筆海外聯貸，展現滙豐跨境協作及整合專業能力，協助客戶拓展全球業務。」
滙豐銀行以客戶需求為核心，從預先識別客戶融資需求，到跨境大型融資、聯貸結構設計、交易執行及分銷，提供完整的一站式服務。滙豐台灣今年首度榮獲《歐元雜誌》(Euromoney)「台灣最佳大型企業銀行」殊榮，並連續第二年獲頒「台灣最佳債券資本市場投資銀行」大獎，持續扮演台灣企業拓展海外市場的重要金融夥伴。
paras_en: HSBC recently, through collaboration of its cross‑market teams, successfully helped Asus, via its wholly‑owned Singapore subsidiary ASUS Global Pte. Ltd., complete a syndicated loan totaling US$2 billion. This is the first overseas syndicated loan for Asus since its founding, marking a landmark achievement. The financing will boost the group’s liquidity and financial flexibility, supporting its operational growth and expansion plans.

The transaction received enthusiastic support from participating banks. Initially targeting US$1 billion, strong lender interest drove the final signed amount up to US$2 billion. This outcome reflects market confidence in Asus’s business strength and long‑term outlook, and showcases HSBC’s ability to help a client raise large‑scale financing in its first syndicated loan. HSBC acted as exclusive coordinator, lead arranger, book‑runner and financing agent, demonstrating its Asia‑Pacific team’s capability to turn market demand into client financing results.

HSBC Taiwan Commercial Bank General Manager Chen Chih‑Chien said: “We are honored to assist Asus in completing its first US$2 billion overseas syndicated loan. The deal demonstrates how HSBC combines deep Taiwan market experience, a global network and cross‑border financing expertise to deliver large‑scale, full‑service financing solutions. As Asus expands into AI servers and data‑center solutions, we look forward to continuing to support its business development and global footprint.”

Asus CFO and spokesperson Wu Chang‑Jung said: “The world is entering an AI super‑cycle, with demand for AI applications soaring. Asus, rooted in brand value, concentrated R&D innovation, and close collaboration with global sales channels and platform partners, will keep enhancing its comprehensive AI strategy covering Cloud AI, Edge AI and Physical AI. This syndicated loan, backed by an international banking syndicate, will inject robust momentum into deepening AI applications and expanding our global presence. Under the ‘Ubiquitous AI, Incredible Possibilities’ strategy, Asus is committed to delivering AI solutions from cloud to edge to meet the diverse needs of enterprise and consumer users worldwide.”

HSBC Asia‑Pacific Syndicated Loans Head Ashish Sharma said: “This deal brought together the professional strengths of HSBC teams in Taiwan, Singapore and Hong Kong. Leveraging deep local market knowledge, extensive syndicated‑loan experience and close teamwork, we tailored and executed Asus’s first overseas syndication, showcasing HSBC’s cross‑border collaboration and integrated expertise in helping clients grow globally.”

HSBC places client needs at the core, from early identification of financing requirements to cross‑border large‑scale financing, syndication structuring, transaction execution and distribution, offering a complete one‑stop service. HSBC Taiwan was this year’s first recipient of Euromoney’s “Best Large Corporate Bank in Taiwan” award and won the “Best Bond Capital Markets Investment Bank in Taiwan” award for the second consecutive year, continuing to serve as a key financial partner for Taiwanese companies expanding overseas.

items.title: 宜進近3個月買進廣達940張 每股均價320.4元
items.title_en: Yijin bought 940 shares of Quanta in the past three months at an average price of NT$320.4 per share
paras: 紡織廠宜進(1457-TW)今(19)日公告，與子公司億東合計自7月17日至10月19日，取得廣達(2382-TW)股票940張，交易總金額約3.01億元，平均每股價格約320.4元，目的為提高資金運用效益。
宜進集團此次取得廣達股票，其中宜進買進500張，平均每股價格約320.32元；億東則買進440張，平均每股價格約320.46元。截至目前，宜進及子公司累計持有廣達460張，投資金額約1.49億元。
回顧先前買賣情形，宜進於與子公司億東自3月9日至7月16日合計取得廣達股票1,093張，但宜進與億東也於3月27日至9月4日期間，處分廣達股票共1,233張，處分利益約1,676.8萬元。
paras_en: Textile firm Yijin (1457‑TW) announced today (19) that together with its subsidiary Yidong, from July 17 to October 19 it acquired 940 shares of Quanta (2382‑TW) for a total transaction amount of about NT$301 million, at an average price of roughly NT$320.4 per share, aiming to improve capital utilization efficiency.

In this purchase, Yijin bought 500 shares at an average price of about NT$320.32 per share, while Yidong bought 440 shares at an average price of about NT$320.46 per share. To date, Yijin and its subsidiary hold a cumulative 460 shares of Quanta, representing an investment of roughly NT$149 million.

Reviewing prior trading activity, Yijin and its subsidiary Yidong together acquired 1,093 shares of Quanta from March 9 to July 16, but they also disposed of 1,233 Quanta shares between March 27 and September 4, realizing disposal gains of approximately NT$16.768 million.

items.title: 神達旗下神雲科技二度回台投資 斥126億元建楊梅新廠、擴增產線
items.title_en: ShenDa subsidiary ShenYun Technology invests in Taiwan for the second time, spending NT$12.62 billion to build a new plant in Yangmei and expand production lines
paras: AI 浪潮持續發酵，帶動高階伺服器與 AI 基礎架構需求劇增。投資台灣事務所今（16）日通過神達 (3706-TW) 旗下子公司神雲科技申請「歡迎台商回台投資行動方案」擴大投資布局，預計砸下重金約 126.2 億元，於桃園市楊梅區興建全新廠房，並於既有竹南廠及林口廠擴增產線，預估將為國內新增 300 個本國就業機會。
神雲科技為神達控股子公司，長期以 MiTAC Computing 品牌服務全球市場，專注提供資料中心與企業級伺服器解決方案。隨著 AI 運算需求衝高，神雲科技近年積極從伺服器平台進一步走向機櫃與 AI 叢集整合，同時全面布局 OCP 開放運算架構，並研發從氣冷到液冷的先進散熱方案，打造涵蓋運算、儲存、網路與散熱的完整 AI 基礎架構，協助全球客戶提升整體效能，大幅創造更高的產品附加價值。
為進一步深化在台灣的高階製造優勢，神雲科技二度申請「歡迎台商回台投資行動方案」。本次規劃的 126.2 億元大投資，將全面導入智慧物聯網（AIoT）、智能倉儲與物流、伺服器自動組裝，以及 AI 電腦視覺檢測設備，大幅升級產線運作彈性與製造精度。同時，廠區也同步建置企業級 AI 算力中心，支援巨量資料分析、智慧排程與數位孿生驗證，加速公司整體營運的智慧化決策。
在綠能與永續發展方面，全案廠房建置導入 BIM 精準施工、智慧能源管理系統（EMS）與太陽能發電設施，全力爭取美國 LEED 黃金級綠建築認證，落實低碳永續目標。業界預估，待此投資案完成後，神雲科技將能顯著擴大高階伺服器及整機櫃產品產能，並進一步鞏固與強化台灣在全球 AI 產業供應鏈中的戰略關鍵地位。
根據經濟部最新統計，截至目前「投資台灣三大方案」已成功吸引 1,830 家企業、累計投資高達約 2 兆 8,435 億元，預估創造 17 萬 481 個本國就業機會。其中，「台商方案」共有 368 家企業參與，總投資金額約 1 兆 5,484 億元，帶來 9 萬 7,136 個就業機會。政府官員透露，目前後續尚有 14 家廠商排隊等待審查，顯示企業擴大在台投資意願依然強勁。
paras_en: The AI wave continues to ferment, driving a surge in demand for high‑end servers and AI infrastructure. The Investment Taiwan office approved on the 16th that ShenYun Technology, a subsidiary of MiTAC (3706‑TW), will expand its investment under the “Welcome Taiwanese Investors Back to Taiwan” program, planning to spend about NT$12.62 billion to build a brand‑new factory in Yangmei District, Taoyuan City, and to add production lines at its existing Zhunan and Linkou plants, which is expected to create roughly 300 domestic jobs.

ShenYun Technology, a MiTAC holding subsidiary, has long served the global market under the MiTAC Computing brand, focusing on data‑center and enterprise‑grade server solutions. As AI compute demand climbs, ShenYun has recently moved beyond server platforms toward rack‑level and AI‑cluster integration, fully embracing OCP open‑compute architecture and developing advanced cooling solutions from air‑ to liquid‑cooling, creating a complete AI infrastructure that covers compute, storage, networking and thermal management to help global customers boost overall performance and generate higher product value.

To further deepen its high‑end manufacturing advantage in Taiwan, ShenYun is applying for the “Welcome Taiwanese Investors Back to Taiwan” program for the second time. The NT$12.62 billion investment will comprehensively introduce AIoT, smart warehousing and logistics, automated server assembly, and AI computer‑vision inspection equipment, greatly enhancing production‑line flexibility and manufacturing precision. At the same time, the site will host an enterprise‑grade AI computing center to support massive data analytics, intelligent scheduling and digital‑twin verification, accelerating smart decision‑making across the company.

Regarding green energy and sustainability, the entire plant will incorporate BIM‑based precision construction, a smart energy‑management system (EMS) and solar power facilities, aiming for U.S. LEED Gold certification and a low‑carbon, sustainable footprint. Industry analysts estimate that once the project is completed, ShenYun will significantly expand capacity for high‑end servers and full‑rack products, further consolidating Taiwan’s strategic role in the global AI supply chain.

According to the latest Ministry of Economic Affairs statistics, the three major “Invest Taiwan” programs have so far attracted 1,830 companies with cumulative investments of about NT$2.08435 trillion, projected to create 174,481 domestic jobs. Of these, the “Taiwanese Investor” scheme involves 368 companies with total investments of roughly NT$1.05484 trillion, generating 97,136 jobs. Government officials said another 14 firms are currently queued for review, indicating that corporate appetite for expanding investment in Taiwan remains strong.

items.title: 供需缺口擴大！研調機構：今年光纖現貨價料將倍速增長  資料中心需求短缺恐延續至2028年
items.title_en: Supply-Demand Gap Widens! Research Firm Says Fiber Optic Spot Prices Could Grow Tenfold This Year, Data Center Shortage May Last Until 2028
paras: 根據TrendForce最新研究，受AI資料中心、跨資料互連及高容量骨幹網路建設推升，預估2026年全球光纖供需缺口將達1.8億芯公里，供給緊縮帶動成品現貨價格年增2.8至5倍以上，電信廠商已開始調整採購模式，轉向長約布局以提前鎖定資源。
供給方面，全球光纖產能稼動率2026年升至92%，庫存由2024年的4個月降至僅1個月，部分主要廠商訂單已排至2027年第一季。光棒擴產涉及沉積設備與製程，建設期約18至24個月，短期難以有效增加供給。
至於需求，2026年全球光纖需求估計達5.77億芯公里，成長動能主要來自資料中心建設，佔比約18%至20%，2027年比重將提升至30%至35%。除大型雲端服務商外，晶片廠商及電信商也投入相關基礎建設，進一步帶動互連與骨幹需求。
價格方面，資料中心內抗彎光纖均價年增逾5倍，AI骨幹光纖漲2.8倍，電信服務主流光纖漲3.7倍。在供給持續吃緊下，Verizon已與康寧簽署多年供應協議，2027至2032年間取得逾1.29億芯公里高密度光纖，用於寬頻與AI資料中心連接。
TrendForce認為，本輪光纖緊張源自AI新增需求擴大，不同於過去電信週期。考量短期供給難增、需求穩健成長，電信與基礎設施廠商透過長約鎖定資源的趨勢將更普遍。
paras_en: According to TrendForce’s latest research, AI data centers, cross‑data interconnects and high‑capacity backbone network construction are driving demand, and the global fiber‑optic supply‑demand gap is projected to reach 180 million core‑kilometers by 2026. The tightening supply is expected to push finished‑goods spot prices up by 2.8‑to‑5‑times year‑over‑year, prompting telecom vendors to shift to long‑term contracts to lock in resources early.

On the supply side, global fiber‑optic capacity utilization is forecast to rise to 92% in 2026, with inventory falling from four months in 2024 to just one month. Some major manufacturers already have orders booked through the first quarter of 2027. Expanding fiber‑rod production requires deposition equipment and processing lines, with construction cycles of roughly 18‑24 months, making short‑term supply increases difficult.

Demand in 2026 is estimated at 577 million core‑kilometers globally, driven mainly by data‑center builds, which account for about 18‑20% of total demand and are expected to rise to 30‑35% in 2027. In addition to large cloud providers, chip makers and telecom operators are investing in related infrastructure, further boosting interconnect and backbone needs.

Price-wise, the average price of bend‑resistant fiber inside data centers has risen more than five‑fold annually, AI backbone fiber has jumped 2.8‑times, and mainstream telecom fiber has increased 3.7‑times. With supply remaining tight, Verizon has signed a multi‑year supply deal with Corning to secure over 129 million core‑kilometers of high‑density fiber for broadband and AI data‑center connections between 2027 and 2032.

TrendForce believes this round of fiber tightness stems from the surge in AI‑driven demand, which differs from past telecom cycles. Given the difficulty of expanding supply in the short term and the steady growth in demand, the trend of telecom and infrastructure firms locking in resources through long‑term contracts is expected to become more widespread.

items.title: AI熱潮退燒？避險基金急砍科技股 半導體挨刀最重
items.title_en: AI Hype Cools? Hedge Funds Slash Tech Stocks, Semiconductors Hit Hardest
paras: 高盛(GS-US)主經紀商業務部門數據顯示，避險基金近期以至少十年來最快速度削減科技股部位。在全球AI交易退燒、科技股重挫之際，基金加速降低曝險，淨槓桿也降至一年低點，反映操作轉趨保守。
根據高盛全球銀行與市場部門發布的報告，截至10月15日的五個交易日，避險基金削減科技股部位的比例，創下高盛自2016年開始統計以來最大紀錄。同期間，整體交易活動的降幅也創近三個月最大。
這波減碼正值全球科技股遭遇猛烈拋售。那斯達克100指數上周下跌5.5%，創2025年4月以來最差單周表現，AI相關交易在全球市場出現平倉潮。在高盛統計涵蓋的五個交易日內，科技類股也是MSCI世界指數中表現最差的族群。
高盛指出，避險基金對全球股票的淨賣出強度，相較過去一年資金流量分布，達到兩個標準差的水準，顯示賣壓明顯偏高。其中，資訊科技類股的淨賣出幅度遠高於其他類股，多空部位合計的縮減規模創兩個月最大；若以金額衡量，半導體股受到的衝擊最重。
不過，大幅減碼並不代表避險基金已全面撤離科技股。報告顯示，科技股淨配置仍占高盛全球主經紀商業務所追蹤投資組合的23.5%，相較過去五年仍處於第90百分位，亦即高於約九成的歷史觀察值，顯示持倉仍偏重科技股。
另一方面，衡量多頭部位超過空頭部位程度的淨槓桿，已降至48.6%，創一年低點。這意味避險基金雖仍保有可觀的科技股部位，整體承擔的方向性風險已下降，對後市的態度更加審慎。
paras_en: Goldman Sachs (GS-US) prime brokerage data shows hedge funds have recently cut tech stock positions at the fastest pace in at least a decade. As global AI trading cools and tech stocks tumble, funds are accelerating exposure reductions, with net leverage falling to a one‑year low, reflecting a more conservative stance.

According to a report from Goldman Sachs Global Banking & Markets, over the five trading days ending October 15, the proportion of tech stock reductions by hedge funds hit the highest level recorded since Goldman began tracking the metric in 2016. During the same period, overall trading activity also fell by the largest margin in nearly three months.

This wave of trimming comes as global tech stocks face a fierce sell‑off. The Nasdaq‑100 fell 5.5% last week, marking its worst weekly performance since April 2025, and AI‑related trades have been liquidated worldwide. In the five‑day window covered by Goldman, tech stocks were the worst‑performing sector in the MSCI World Index.

Goldman notes that hedge funds’ net selling intensity in global equities reached two standard deviations above the distribution of fund flows over the past year, indicating markedly high selling pressure. Information technology stocks saw net sell volumes far exceeding other sectors, with the combined long‑short position reduction hitting a two‑month maximum; in dollar terms, semiconductor stocks bore the brunt of the impact.

However, the sizable cuts do not mean hedge funds have fully exited tech stocks. The report shows that net tech exposure still accounts for 23.5% of the portfolios tracked by Goldman’s global prime brokerage, placing it in the 90th percentile over the past five years—about nine‑tenths above historical averages—indicating a continued bias toward tech holdings.

Meanwhile, net leverage, which measures long positions relative to short positions, has fallen to 48.6%, a one‑year low. This suggests that while hedge funds still hold substantial tech positions, their overall directional risk exposure has decreased, reflecting a more cautious outlook for the market ahead.

items.title: AI燒錢還有看不見的帳？標普警告科技巨頭負債恐高於已知規模
items.title_en: S&P Warns Tech Giants' AI Debt May Exceed Known Scale
paras: 標普全球警告，全球大型科技公司的AI相關債務與潛在負債，可能高於目前外界掌握的規模。隨著業者透過相互連結的融資安排支撐資料中心建設，部分財務承擔未必已充分反映在公開資訊中。不過，標普目前仍認為，沒有必要因此調整相關企業的信用評等。
近幾周，AI基礎設施供應商與新型雲端業者發行的債券持續承壓，包括獲輝達(NVDA-US)支持的CoreWeave(CRWV-US)。市場擔憂，這些企業為擴張算力而大舉借貸，可能帶來過高的財務風險。
標普全球數位基礎設施主管哈比布(Mark Habib)在倫敦一場圓桌會議上表示，對超大規模雲端業者而言，信用評等面臨的最大風險，仍是預期獲利最終未能實現。
他也特別點出「相互連結的融資結構」：大型科技公司可能實質上為巨額資料中心建設，或規模較小的AI公司提供擔保，使其財務風險不只限於直接借款。
哈比布表示：「可以合理假設，還有更多我們尚未看到的債務。」如果相關負債未被揭露，或標普未參與可能產生這些責任的交易評等，就可能無法掌握完整情況。
標普預估，美國六大超大規模雲端業者，包括亞馬遜(AMZN-US)、微軟(MSFT-US)、Alphabet(GOOGL-US)、甲骨文(ORCL-US)、Meta(META-US)與SpaceX(SPCX-US)，2025年至2030年間投入資料中心及其他AI相關資本支出的金額，將超過7兆美元，自由現金流則預料至少到明年仍為負值。
對於這類循環融資安排可能為企業資產負債表增加多少債務，哈比布表示，目前尚無估計數字，但標普正嘗試從整體角度評估相關風險。
標普今年7月已因擔憂甲骨文的AI支出，以及其「獲利路徑仍不明確」，將該公司信用評等調降至BBB-，也就是投資等級的最低一級。
近期AI相關債券遭到拋售，也引發市場是否已認為其風險高於信用評等所反映程度的疑問。對此，哈比布表示，目前標普並不認為兩者出現重大落差，足以迫使其調整評等，並強調信用評等著眼於較長期的表現。
不過，若愈來愈明確的跡象顯示，企業支出規模已無法持續，標普便可能改變看法。哈比布指出，業者進一步擴大投資，或市場競爭過於激烈、影響營收前景，都可能成為觸發重新評估的因素。
paras_en: S&P Global warns that AI‑related debt and potential liabilities of large global tech companies could be larger than currently understood, as firms use interconnected financing arrangements to support data‑center construction, with some financial commitments not fully reflected in public information. However, S&P still sees no need to adjust the credit ratings of the affected companies.

In recent weeks, bonds issued by AI infrastructure providers and new‑wave cloud operators have remained under pressure, including CoreWeave (CRWV‑US) backed by Nvidia (NVDA‑US). The market worries that these firms are borrowing heavily to expand compute capacity, which could create excessive financial risk.

Mark Habib, head of digital infrastructure at S&P Global, told a round‑table in London that for ultra‑large cloud providers the biggest rating risk remains the possibility that expected profits ultimately fail to materialise.

He highlighted the “interconnected financing structure”: large tech firms may effectively guarantee massive data‑center builds or smaller AI companies, extending financial risk beyond direct borrowing.

Habib said, “It is reasonable to assume there is more debt we have not yet seen.” If such liabilities are undisclosed, or S&P is not involved in rating the transactions that could generate them, the full picture may be missed.

S&P estimates that the six biggest U.S. ultra‑large cloud providers—Amazon (AMZN‑US), Microsoft (MSFT‑US), Alphabet (GOOGL‑US), Oracle (ORCL‑US), Meta (META‑US) and SpaceX (SPCX‑US)—will spend over $7 trillion on data‑center and other AI‑related capital expenditures between 2025 and 2030, with free cash flow expected to remain negative at least through next year.

Regarding how much such circular financing arrangements could add to corporate balance sheets, Habib said there is currently no estimate, but S&P is trying to assess the risk from a holistic perspective.
In July this year S&P downgraded Oracle to BBB‑ after concerns over its AI spending and an “unclear profit pathway,” placing it at the lowest tier of investment‑grade ratings.

Recent sell‑offs of AI‑linked bonds have raised questions about whether the market now views the risk as higher than the credit ratings suggest. Habib responded that S&P does not see a material gap sufficient to trigger a rating change and stressed that ratings focus on longer‑term performance.

However, if increasingly clear signs emerge that corporate spending levels are unsustainable, S&P may change its view. Habib noted that further investment expansion, overly intense market competition, or weakened revenue outlooks could all trigger a reassessment.

items.title: Mac能觸控、iPad mini換OLED？蘋果月底發表會亮點一次看
items.title_en: Mac Touchscreen, iPad mini Switching to OLED? Apple Event Highlights at Month-End
paras: 蘋果(AAPL-US)將於10月28日舉行「Pro and tell」發表會，繼本月智慧家庭新品登場後，再度更新產品陣容。這次焦點預料將轉向Mac與iPad，包括外界期待已久的OLED觸控版MacBook Pro、新款iPad mini，以及搭載M6晶片的MacBook Pro與iMac。
蘋果已向受邀者發送活動邀請，全球行銷資深副總裁喬斯維亞克(Greg Joswiak)也在社群平台X發布活動標誌，預告下周登場。目前各款新品規格仍以市場傳聞為主，預定11月6日進行的零售門市布置更新，則被視為新品可能於當天開賣的線索。
今年秋季蘋果新品推出節奏格外密集，8月底先更新Mac mini與Mac Studio，9月發表iPhone、Apple Watch與AirPods新品，10月再推出HomeView、HomePod mini 2及新版Apple TV 4K。相較之下，iPad與筆電產品尚未在這波秋季更新中登場，因而成為月底發表會的關注重點。

iPad mini傳升級OLED 螢幕與晶片成改款焦點

第八代iPad mini預料將以螢幕升級為主要賣點。市場傳聞指出，新機可能採用8.4吋LTPS混合式OLED面板，改善亮度、色彩表現，讓iPad mini也加入OLED產品行列，但規格未必與iPad Pro相同。
至於是否支援ProMotion高更新率技術，目前仍有不同說法，尚不能確定。法國監管網站近期出現與iPad mini相關的裝置識別資訊，則被視為新品接近推出的另一項跡象。
處理器方面，A20是目前傳聞較看好的選項，新機也可能導入蘋果自研的無線連網與數據機晶片。其他傳聞包括調整FaceTime相機位置，以及採用新式振動發聲揚聲器，以改善防水表現。

MacBook Pro傳迎觸控 OLED之外也可能減重

OLED MacBook Pro是另一項重頭戲。這款產品原先被預期於2027年初推出，如今市場認為，可能提前至今年10月發表、11月上市。
OLED螢幕可帶來更鮮明的色彩與更高對比度，也具有省電潛力。若同時導入觸控功能，將成為首款支援觸控操作的MacBook，讓蘋果加入已有多款觸控產品的筆電市場。
10月5日，有人在macOS 27.2開發者測試版中發現，多款應用程式出現新增觸控辨識能力的相關線索，被解讀為蘋果正為觸控Mac做準備，但仍不等於官方確認產品規格。
機身設計方面，10月4日的報導稱，蘋果可能透過縮小零組件尺寸、採用更輕的設計，明顯降低新機重量。不過，10月8日另一篇報導則修正了先前有關機身將變薄的說法，因此「減重」與「變薄」仍須分開看待。

M6入門款與iMac料偏重效能 其他新品可能等到明年

除了OLED觸控機型，蘋果也可能推出搭載M6晶片的入門款MacBook Pro，延續8月底M6 Mac mini的更新腳步。
據傳，這款入門機型仍會保留支援ProMotion的mini LED螢幕，六揚聲器音響系統、連接埠與機身設計也與現行版本相同，主要升級將集中在M6晶片帶來的效能提升，與OLED觸控款有所區隔。
24吋iMac預料也採取類似策略，換上M6晶片，但維持現有外觀與螢幕。雖然市場曾傳出iMac未來可能採用OLED，這次更新仍不預期出現這項變化。
至於MacBook Air、MacBook Neo、iPhone Air 2、iPhone 18、iPhone 18e，以及iPad Air、iPad Pro與入門款iPad等產品，相關更新傳聞目前較指向2027年初，並非這次月底活動的主要預期名單。
paras_en: Apple (AAPL-US) will hold a "Pro and tell" event on October 28, updating its product lineup after this month’s smart‑home releases. The focus is expected to shift to Macs and iPads, including the long‑awaited OLED touchscreen MacBook Pro, a new iPad mini, and MacBook Pro and iMac models powered by the M6 chip.

Apple has sent invitations to attendees, and senior vice president of worldwide marketing Greg Joswiak posted the event logo on X, teasing the launch next week. Specifications for the new products remain based on market rumors, and the retail‑store refresh slated for November 6 is seen as a clue that the devices could go on sale that day.

Apple’s autumn product rollout this year is unusually dense: late August saw updates to the Mac mini and Mac Studio, September brought new iPhone, Apple Watch and AirPods models, and October introduced HomeView, HomePod mini 2 and a new Apple TV 4K. In contrast, iPad and laptop products have not appeared in this wave, making them the focal point of the month‑end event.

The iPad mini is expected to be refreshed mainly with a screen upgrade. Rumors suggest the new device could use an 8.4‑inch LTPS hybrid OLED panel, improving brightness and colour performance and adding the iPad mini to Apple’s OLED lineup, though its specs may not match those of the iPad Pro.

Whether it will support ProMotion’s high refresh rate is still debated, and no confirmation exists yet. A French regulatory site recently displayed device identification info related to the iPad mini, which is taken as another sign that the product is nearing launch.

On the processor side, the A20 is the most favoured rumor, and the new iPad mini may also incorporate Apple‑designed wireless and modem chips. Other rumors include moving the FaceTime camera location and using a new vibration‑driven speaker to improve water resistance.
The OLED MacBook Pro is another headline act. Originally expected in early 2027, the market now thinks it could be announced in October and ship in November, potentially ahead of schedule.

An OLED display would deliver more vivid colours, higher contrast and power‑saving benefits. If combined with touch capability, it would become the first touchscreen‑enabled MacBook, bringing Apple into the laptop market that already hosts several touchscreen devices.

On October 5, a developer build of macOS 27.2 showed multiple apps with added touch‑recognition hints, interpreted as Apple preparing a touchscreen Mac, though this does not constitute official confirmation of product specs.

Regarding chassis design, a report on October 4 said Apple might shrink component sizes and use lighter materials to noticeably reduce the new model’s weight. However, a follow‑up report on October 8 corrected earlier claims about the device becoming thinner, so weight reduction and thinness should be considered separately.
Beyond the OLED touchscreen variant, Apple may also launch an entry‑level MacBook Pro with the M6 chip, continuing the M6 Mac mini update introduced at the end of August.

According to rumors, this entry model would retain a ProMotion‑compatible mini‑LED display, a six‑speaker audio system, ports and chassis design identical to the current version, with the main upgrade being the performance boost from the M6 chip, distinguishing it from the OLED touchscreen version.

The 24‑inch iMac is also expected to follow a similar strategy, swapping in the M6 chip while keeping its existing look and screen. Although there were whispers that future iMacs might adopt OLED, this refresh is not expected to bring that change.

As for the MacBook Air, MacBook Neo, iPhone Air 2, iPhone 18, iPhone 18e, as well as iPad Air, iPad Pro and entry‑level iPad, related rumors point to early 2027 releases and are not part of the primary expectations for this month‑end event.

items.title: Mac終於能用手點？蘋果10月28日發表會 傳推首款觸控筆電
items.title_en: Apple to Unveil First Touchscreen MacBook Pro at October 28 Event
paras: 蘋果(AAPL-US)周一(19日)宣布，將於10月28日在洛杉磯舉行產品發表會，主題為「Pro and tell」。據《彭博》報導，蘋果計畫在活動中推出首款觸控螢幕MacBook Pro，並更新多款Mac與iPad產品，為多年來堅持區隔Mac與iPad使用體驗的策略帶來重大轉變。
新款觸控MacBook Pro預計搭載OLED螢幕，提供更清晰的顯示效果，並導入類似iPhone的動態島(Dynamic Island)介面。觸控、OLED與動態島都將首次出現在Mac產品上。
不過，新機預計仍採用M5 Pro與M5 Max晶片，與今年3月推出的現行MacBook Pro相同，這次改款重點將落在螢幕與操作介面。
《彭博》先前報導，蘋果也將推出搭載M6晶片的入門款MacBook Pro、更新版iMac，以及螢幕更清晰的新版iPad mini。這意味同場亮相的MacBook Pro產品，預計將分別採用M6與M5 Pro、M5 Max晶片。
蘋果近幾周已密集發表新品，包括HomeView、HomePod mini 2與更新版Apple TV機上盒；旗下首款摺疊iPhone「iPhone Duo」則將於本周五開賣，接續由Mac與iPad新品登場。
《彭博》周日另報導，蘋果零售門市正準備於11月6日周五開始銷售新品，但各款產品的確切上市安排，仍待蘋果正式公布。
觸控MacBook Pro將是這波新品的重要焦點。蘋果過去多年強調，不會將iPad與Mac的使用體驗結合，如今計畫把觸控操作與iPhone上的動態島帶進Mac，顯示其筆電產品設計方向出現明顯轉變。
paras_en: Apple (AAPL-US) announced on Monday (the 19th) that it will hold a product launch event in Los Angeles on October 28, themed “Pro and tell.” Bloomberg reports that Apple plans to debut its first touchscreen MacBook Pro at the event and refresh a range of Mac and iPad products, marking a major shift in its long‑standing strategy of keeping Mac and iPad experiences separate.

The new touchscreen MacBook Pro is expected to feature an OLED display for sharper visuals and will incorporate a Dynamic Island interface similar to that on the iPhone. Touch input, OLED and Dynamic Island will appear on a Mac product for the first time.

However, the new model is still expected to use the M5 Pro and M5 Max chips, the same as the current MacBook Pro launched in March this year, with the redesign focusing on the screen and user interface.

Bloomberg previously reported that Apple will also launch an entry‑level MacBook Pro with an M6 chip, an updated iMac, and a new iPad mini with a clearer display. This suggests that the MacBook Pro models unveiled at the same event will likely come with M6 as well as M5 Pro and M5 Max processors.

In recent weeks Apple has been rolling out new products, including HomeView, a second‑generation HomePod mini and an updated Apple TV set‑top box; its first foldable iPhone, the “iPhone Duo,” is slated to go on sale this Friday, following the Mac and iPad announcements.

Bloomberg reported on Sunday that Apple’s retail stores are preparing to start selling the new products on Friday, November 6, though the exact launch schedule for each item remains to be confirmed by Apple.

The touchscreen MacBook Pro will be a key focus of this product wave. After years of emphasizing that iPad and Mac experiences would remain separate, Apple now plans to bring touch interaction and the iPhone’s Dynamic Island to the Mac, indicating a clear shift in its laptop design direction.

items.title: 標普500第三季獲利靠這5家扛：美光、輝達領軍 另外3家憑什麼入列？
items.title_en: S&P 500 Q3 Earnings Powered by These Five: Micron and Nvidia Lead, Why the Other Three Made the List?
paras: 根據 FactSet最新報告，美光(MU-US) 、輝達(NVDA-US) 、Meta(META-US) 、EchoStar(ECHO-US) 與波音(BA-US) ，預計將成為標準普爾 500 指數第三季獲利成長的最大功臣。這無疑是一個令人意想不到的五人組合。
美光與輝達成為獲利成長的主力並不令人意外。隨著記憶體晶片需求暴增，加上供不應求帶動價格飆升，美光已躍升為「印鈔機」。
至於輝達，儘管享受人工智慧（AI）熱潮紅利已有數年，其獲利表現依然保持強勁成長。
在 FactSet 界定的第三季區間中，美光的財報已率先開出，其截至 8 月的季度獲利暴增逾 1,000%；輝達截至 10 月的季度每股盈餘（EPS）預估將成長 90%，淨利則逼近 600 億美元。
FactSet 報告指出，另外三家公司能成為主要貢獻者，原因則較為特殊。
Meta、EchoStar 與波音在 2025 年第三季均列支了鉅額費用與支出，進而拖累當時的獲利表現，由於本季財報將與該期進行基期比較，這三家公司預計將迎來極為顯著的轉機行情。
舉例來說，Meta 的獲利預計將成長超過 500%；衛星技術公司 EchoStar 預估將擺脫去年同期每股虧損 1.06 美元的陰霾，轉虧為盈至每股獲利 0.17 美元。
波音去年同期因 777X 客機延誤而提列了 49 億美元的稅前減損，本季虧損幅度和當時相比預料將大幅收窄。
此外，非上市公司投資收益仍是最大變數。FactSet 資深獲利分析師 John Butters 在報告中提及，Alphabet(GOOGL-US) 第二季受惠於股權投資收益，認列了 98 億美元的其他收入，亞馬遜(AMZN-US)亦認列了 53 億美元的收益。
這些數字主要反映持有 Anthropic 與SpaceX(SPCX-US) 股權的帳面收益，使 Alphabet 與亞馬遜意外成為當季標普 500 指數獲利成長的最大貢獻來源。
上周已有部分企業陸續公布第三季財報，接下來一周財報發布步調將加快，標普 500 指數成分股中將有 79 家企業公布業績。
特斯拉(TSLA-US) 、Meta 與 IBM(IBM-US) 是科技業焦點，三家公司均將於周三(21日)公布財報。SpaceX 雖非標普 500 指數成分股，也將於周二(20日)公布業績。
根據 FactSet 報告，綜合已公布的業績與尚未公布財報企業的預估值，第三季整體獲利年增率預估為 29%；若扣除美光與輝達的貢獻，預估增幅則為 20%。
paras_en: According to the latest FactSet report, Micron (MU-US), Nvidia (NVDA-US), Meta (META-US), EchoStar (ECHO-US) and Boeing (BA-US) are expected to be the biggest contributors to S&P 500 earnings growth in the third quarter, an unexpectedly diverse five‑company lineup.

Micron and Nvidia’s roles as earnings drivers are not surprising. A surge in demand for memory chips, coupled with supply shortages that have pushed prices skyward, has turned Micron into a “money‑printing machine.”
As for Nvidia, even after several years of riding the artificial‑intelligence (AI) boom, its profit performance continues to show strong growth.

In FactSet’s defined third‑quarter window, Micron’s earnings report was the first to be released, showing a quarterly profit jump of more than 1,000% as of August; Nvidia’s earnings per share (EPS) for the quarter ending in October is projected to rise 90%, with net income approaching $60 billion.
FactSet notes that the other three companies become major contributors for more specific reasons.

Meta, EchoStar and Boeing each booked large expenses and charges in the third quarter of 2025, which depressed their earnings at that time; because this quarter’s results will be compared to that base period, the three are expected to experience a pronounced earnings turnaround.
For example, Meta’s profit is projected to grow by more than 500%; satellite‑technology firm EchoStar is expected to swing from a loss of $1.06 per share a year ago to a profit of $0.17 per share.
Boeing recorded a pre‑tax impairment of $4.9 billion last year due to delays with the 777X, and this quarter’s loss is expected to narrow dramatically relative to that figure.

In addition, earnings from non‑public‑company investments remain the biggest variable. FactSet senior earnings analyst John Butters cited that Alphabet (GOOGL-US) recognized $9.8 billion of other income in Q2 from equity investments, while Amazon (AMZN-US) recorded $5.3 billion of similar gains.
These figures mainly reflect book‑value gains on stakes in Anthropic and SpaceX (SPCX-US), making Alphabet and Amazon unexpected top contributors to S&P 500 earnings growth this quarter.
Some companies have already released Q3 results last week, and the pace of earnings releases will accelerate over the next week, with 79 S&P 500 constituents slated to report.
Tesla (TSLA-US), Meta and IBM (IBM-US) are the tech‑sector focus, all set to report on Wednesday (the 21st). SpaceX, although not an S&P 500 component, will report on Tuesday (the 20th).

FactSet estimates that, combining reported results with forecasts for companies yet to report, overall Q3 earnings are expected to grow 29% year‑over‑year; excluding Micron and Nvidia’s contributions, the increase is projected at 20%.

items.title: 不只GPU！輝達CPU搶下Modal業務 挑戰英特爾、超微
items.title_en: Not Just GPUs! Nvidia’s CPU Wins Modal Business, Challenging Intel and AMD
paras: 輝達(NVDA-US)拓展中央處理器(CPU)市場再下一城。快速成長的AI雲端新創Modal宣布，將首次採用輝達新款Vera處理器，執行可替使用者完成長時間任務的AI代理。這類工作過去全由英特爾(INTC-US)與超微(AMD-US)晶片負責，顯示輝達進軍兩大對手長期主導的市場已有初步成果。
Modal向AI開發者出租算力，上周完成由Accel領投的7.5億美元募資，估值達157.5億美元。公司表示，服務使用量已增至原本三倍，營收較去年同期成長逾15倍，未來一年營收可望達10億美元。
Modal周一(19日)表示，初步測試顯示，Vera讓AI代理可完成的工作量提高至原本兩倍，促使公司首度支援輝達的CPU設計，但也需要對軟體進行深入調整。
不過，執行長伯恩哈德森(Erik Bernhardsson)強調，Modal不會放棄既有供應商，而是將輝達晶片與英特爾、超微產品搭配使用，依各項任務需求，分配至表現最好的硬體。
他也指出，這次測試比較的是英特爾與超微已上市的晶片，兩家公司正在開發的新款產品，可能縮小與輝達的差距。Modal將在新品推出後測試，混合使用不同供應商硬體，能讓公司隨時部署效能最佳的產品。
輝達先前向投資人表示，預期本會計年度Vera銷售額至少達200億美元，藉此切入公司估計規模約2,000億美元的CPU市場。除了Modal，輝達曾透露，OpenAI、Anthropic、甲骨文(ORCL-US)及Perplexity等業者也計畫採用Vera，擴大其在AI運算領域的布局。
paras_en: Nvidia (NVDA-US) scores another win as it expands into the central processing unit (CPU) market. Fast‑growing AI cloud startup Modal announced it will for the first time use Nvidia’s new Vera processor to run AI agents that can handle long‑duration tasks for users. Such workloads have historically been handled exclusively by Intel (INTC-US) and AMD (AMD-US) chips, showing that Nvidia is beginning to make inroads into a market long dominated by its two biggest rivals.

Modal rents compute power to AI developers and last week closed a $750 million financing round led by Accel, valuing the company at $15.75 billion. The firm said usage of its services has risen to three times its prior level and revenue has grown more than 15‑fold year‑over‑year, with revenue expected to reach $1 billion within the next year.

On Monday (the 19th), Modal reported that early tests show Vera doubles the amount of work AI agents can accomplish, prompting the company to support Nvidia’s CPU design for the first time, though it also requires deep software adjustments.

However, CEO Erik Bernhardsson stressed that Modal will not abandon its existing suppliers; instead it will pair Nvidia chips with Intel and AMD products, allocating tasks to the hardware that delivers the best performance for each workload.

He also noted that the comparison in this test involved Intel’s and AMD’s currently available chips, and that new products the two companies are developing could narrow the gap with Nvidia. Modal will test after the new releases, and a hybrid approach using hardware from different vendors will allow the company to deploy the most efficient solutions at any time.

Nvidia previously told investors it expects Vera sales to reach at least $20 billion this fiscal year, giving it a foothold in the roughly $200 billion CPU market it estimates. In addition to Modal, Nvidia has disclosed that OpenAI, Anthropic, Oracle (ORCL-US) and Perplexity also plan to use Vera, expanding its footprint in AI computing.

items.title: 美股兩大力量死鬥！美債殖利率狂飆 AI股賺翻也難漲
items.title_en: U.S. Stocks Clash Between Two Forces: Soaring Treasury Yields and AI Stocks Struggle to Rise
paras: 華爾街正迎來一場高風險的正面交鋒。科技與能源巨頭亮眼的企業獲利，正硬生生撞上持續狂飆的債券殖利率。
在人工智慧（AI）技術基礎設施與資料中心建置潮的推動下，法人分析師預期企業獲利將持續強勁成長。正是這份高昂的期待，支撐著標普500等主要指數今年一路克服多重利空。
伊朗局勢推升國際油價衝破每桶百元大關，讓本就承受高物價壓力的消費者負擔加劇；與此同時，10年期與30年期美國公債殖利率攀升至數十年新高，更為股市增添了一道沉重的逆風。
市場走向雙軌化：AI概念股獨撐大局後轉弱
殖利率飆升加劇了美股市場的分化。阿波羅全球管理公司首席經濟學家史洛克（Torsten Slok）指出，當前市場已裂變為「AI概念股」與「非AI概念股」兩大陣營。
自8月起，大盤漲勢明顯收窄，即使大多數個股陷入苦戰，主要指數表面上仍維持高檔。這股平衡直到過去一週才破功，原先強勢的AI概念股突然遭遇賣壓。
雪上加霜的是，即使油價持續走高，美債殖利率出現回檔，反映市場避險情緒升溫；投資人則順勢轉回先前受高利率壓抑的類股與個股。
財報門檻大幅提高：投資人開始質疑AI成長故事
數月以來，投資人將焦點全數鎖定在獲利表現，使AI概念股幾乎免疫於小型股及其他利率敏感股所承受的打擊。
然而，隨著市場對AI驅動的成長敘事開始存疑，這些股票要繼續推升股價的門檻已大幅提高。
在大型銀行與百事可樂（PepsiCo）等消費巨頭搶先公布的財報未能驚艷市場後，恢復市場信心 重擔，已落在即將公布最新財測與業績的AI核心受益股身上。
Nationwide首席市場策略師哈克特（Mark Hackett）直言：「市場的疑慮正持續升溫。」
獲利爆發力對決資金成本：估值修正引發長短力道拉鋸
隨著債券殖利率上周五(16日)繼續攀升，市場似乎正走向兩股強大力量的拉鋸。
Founders 100 ETF投資組合經理莫納漢（Michael Monaghan）表示，一方面，企業獲利成長速度已達到通常只有經濟復甦初期才會出現的強勁水準；另一方面，推升債券殖利率的力量，短期內似乎不太可能消退。
莫納漢表示：「市場正處於拉鋸之中。儘管今年以來股市上漲，但相較於明年的獲利預估，目前股價已便宜許多。」
雖然股價仍有支撐，估值，也就是投資人願意為每一美元預期獲利支付的價格，卻已明顯下滑。根據FactSet資料，截至上周五，標普500指數的預估本益比為19倍，低於過去5年與10年的平均水準。
富達投資全球總經主管提默（Jurrien Timmer）表示，認為科技股能免受日益加劇的總體經濟壓力影響，並不完全正確。
提默在訪談中表示：「可以把它想成獲利成長在分子、資金成本在分母。目前獲利正突飛猛進，但資金成本也在上升。兩者正在競速，就看哪一方對股價的影響更大。」
paras_en: Wall Street is facing a high‑risk head‑to‑head battle. Stellar earnings from tech and energy giants are colliding head‑on with continuously soaring bond yields.

Driven by the wave of AI infrastructure and data‑center construction, sell‑side analysts expect corporate earnings to keep growing strongly. This lofty expectation has helped major indices such as the S&P 500 overcome multiple headwinds this year.

Iran’s situation has pushed international oil prices above $100 a barrel, further burdening consumers already feeling high price pressure; at the same time, 10‑year and 30‑year U.S. Treasury yields have climbed to multi‑decade highs, adding a heavy headwind for equities.
The market is moving on two tracks: AI‑related stocks, after initially supporting the market, are now weakening.

Yield spikes have intensified the split in the U.S. equity market. Torsten Slok, chief economist at Apollo Global Management, notes that the market has now fractured into two camps – “AI‑themed stocks” and “non‑AI stocks.”

Since August, the broad market’s rally has noticeably narrowed. Even though many individual stocks are struggling, the main indices have superficially stayed at elevated levels. This balance only broke in the past week, when once‑strong AI stocks suddenly faced selling pressure.

Adding insult to injury, even as oil prices keep rising, Treasury yields have pulled back, reflecting heightened market‑risk aversion; investors are shifting back into sectors and stocks that were previously suppressed by high rates.
Earnings thresholds have risen sharply: investors begin to doubt the AI growth story
For months, investors have focused exclusively on earnings performance, making AI‑themed stocks almost immune to the blows that hit small‑caps and other rate‑sensitive stocks.
However, as the market’s confidence in AI‑driven growth narratives wanes, the hurdle for these stocks to keep pushing prices higher has risen dramatically.

After earnings from large banks and consumer giants such as PepsiCo failed to wow the market, the burden of restoring confidence now falls on AI‑core beneficiaries that are about to release fresh forecasts and results.
Mark Hackett, chief market strategist at Nationwide, said plainly: “Market concerns are continuing to heat up.”
Earnings explosiveness versus funding costs: valuation adjustments spark a tug‑of‑war between long and short forces
With bond yields continuing to climb on Friday the 16th, the market appears to be caught in a tug‑of‑war between two powerful forces.

Michael Monaghan, portfolio manager of the Founders 100 ETF, said that on one hand, corporate earnings growth has reached a robust pace normally seen only in the early stages of an economic recovery; on the other hand, the forces driving yields higher seem unlikely to subside in the short term.
Monaghan added: “The market is in a tug‑of‑war. Although stocks have risen so far this year, relative to next year’s earnings outlook, today’s prices are already much cheaper.”

While stock prices still have support, valuations – the price investors are willing to pay for each dollar of expected earnings – have clearly slipped. According to FactSet, as of last Friday the S&P 500’s forward P/E ratio stood at 19×, below the five‑year and ten‑year averages.
Jurrien Timmer, global chief economist at Fidelity Investments, said it is not entirely correct to think technology stocks are insulated from the growing macro‑economic pressures.

Timmer explained in an interview: “You can think of it as earnings growth in the numerator and funding costs in the denominator. Earnings are surging, but funding costs are rising too. The two are racing, and it will depend on which side has the bigger impact on stock prices.”

items.title: 俄羅斯確診5例猴痘病例
items.title_en: Russia Confirms 5 Monkeypox Cases
paras: 多家外媒報導，俄羅斯聖彼得堡5名因疑似感染猴痘 (Mpox) 住院的患者，已確認感染。院方表示，患者目前情況穩定，症狀為輕度至中度，正接受醫療照護。
報導援引俄羅斯塔斯社消息指出，聖彼得堡博特金傳染病醫院證實上述病例。
在確診消息公布前，俄羅斯聯邦消費者權益保護暨公益監督局位於聖彼得堡及列寧格勒州的跨區部門，已通報對這5名疑似感染者進行醫療監測。
另在莫斯科州，5名曾與疑似猴痘患者接觸的人員也被送醫觀察。
當地衛生部表示，這5人狀況良好，未出現相關臨床症狀。
截至報導發布時，莫斯科州這5名接觸者尚未獲確認感染，與聖彼得堡的5例確診病例屬不同通報。
俄羅斯衛生監管機關表示，正持續監測疫情，並備有檢測病毒所需的試劑與設備。
paras_en: Multiple foreign media outlets reported that five patients hospitalized in St. Petersburg, Russia, on suspicion of monkeypox (Mpox) infection have been confirmed positive. Hospital officials said the patients are currently stable, with mild to moderate symptoms, and are receiving medical care.
The report, citing Russian TASS news agency, noted that the Botkin Infectious Diseases Hospital in St. Petersburg confirmed the aforementioned cases.

Before the confirmation was announced, the Russian Federal Service for Consumer Rights Protection and Public Welfare Monitoring’s cross‑regional department in St. Petersburg and Leningrad Oblast had reported that the five suspected individuals were placed under medical observation.
In Moscow Oblast, five people who had been in contact with the suspected monkeypox patients were also admitted for observation.
The local health department said the five individuals are in good condition and have not shown any related clinical symptoms.
As of the time the report was released, the five contacts in Moscow Oblast had not been confirmed infected, and their cases are reported separately from the five confirmed cases in St. Petersburg.
Russian health authorities said they continue to monitor the situation and have the reagents and equipment needed to test for the virus.

items.title: 供需缺口擴大！研調機構：今年光纖現貨價料將倍速增長  資料中心需求短缺恐延續至2028年
items.title_en: Supply-Demand Gap Widens! Research Firm Says Fiber Optic Spot Prices Could Grow Tenfold This Year, Data Center Shortage May Last Until 2028
paras: 根據TrendForce最新研究，受AI資料中心、跨資料互連及高容量骨幹網路建設推升，預估2026年全球光纖供需缺口將達1.8億芯公里，供給緊縮帶動成品現貨價格年增2.8至5倍以上，電信廠商已開始調整採購模式，轉向長約布局以提前鎖定資源。
供給方面，全球光纖產能稼動率2026年升至92%，庫存由2024年的4個月降至僅1個月，部分主要廠商訂單已排至2027年第一季。光棒擴產涉及沉積設備與製程，建設期約18至24個月，短期難以有效增加供給。
至於需求，2026年全球光纖需求估計達5.77億芯公里，成長動能主要來自資料中心建設，佔比約18%至20%，2027年比重將提升至30%至35%。除大型雲端服務商外，晶片廠商及電信商也投入相關基礎建設，進一步帶動互連與骨幹需求。
價格方面，資料中心內抗彎光纖均價年增逾5倍，AI骨幹光纖漲2.8倍，電信服務主流光纖漲3.7倍。在供給持續吃緊下，Verizon已與康寧簽署多年供應協議，2027至2032年間取得逾1.29億芯公里高密度光纖，用於寬頻與AI資料中心連接。
TrendForce認為，本輪光纖緊張源自AI新增需求擴大，不同於過去電信週期。考量短期供給難增、需求穩健成長，電信與基礎設施廠商透過長約鎖定資源的趨勢將更普遍。
paras_en: According to TrendForce’s latest research, AI data centers, cross‑data interconnects and high‑capacity backbone network construction are driving demand, and the global fiber‑optic supply‑demand gap is projected to reach 180 million core‑kilometers by 2026. The tightening supply is expected to push finished‑goods spot prices up by 2.8‑to‑5‑times year‑over‑year, prompting telecom vendors to shift to long‑term contracts to lock in resources early.

On the supply side, global fiber‑optic capacity utilization is forecast to rise to 92% in 2026, with inventory falling from four months in 2024 to just one month. Some major manufacturers already have orders booked through the first quarter of 2027. Expanding fiber‑rod production requires deposition equipment and processing lines, with construction cycles of roughly 18‑24 months, making short‑term supply increases difficult.

Demand in 2026 is estimated at 577 million core‑kilometers globally, driven mainly by data‑center builds, which account for about 18‑20% of total demand and are expected to rise to 30‑35% in 2027. In addition to large cloud providers, chip makers and telecom operators are investing in related infrastructure, further boosting interconnect and backbone needs.

Price-wise, the average price of bend‑resistant fiber inside data centers has risen more than five‑fold annually, AI backbone fiber has jumped 2.8‑times, and mainstream telecom fiber has increased 3.7‑times. With supply remaining tight, Verizon has signed a multi‑year supply deal with Corning to secure over 129 million core‑kilometers of high‑density fiber for broadband and AI data‑center connections between 2027 and 2032.

TrendForce believes this round of fiber tightness stems from the surge in AI‑driven demand, which differs from past telecom cycles. Given the difficulty of expanding supply in the short term and the steady growth in demand, the trend of telecom and infrastructure firms locking in resources through long‑term contracts is expected to become more widespread.

items.title: AI熱潮退燒？避險基金急砍科技股 半導體挨刀最重
items.title_en: AI Hype Cools? Hedge Funds Slash Tech Stocks, Semiconductors Hit Hardest
paras: 高盛(GS-US)主經紀商業務部門數據顯示，避險基金近期以至少十年來最快速度削減科技股部位。在全球AI交易退燒、科技股重挫之際，基金加速降低曝險，淨槓桿也降至一年低點，反映操作轉趨保守。
根據高盛全球銀行與市場部門發布的報告，截至10月15日的五個交易日，避險基金削減科技股部位的比例，創下高盛自2016年開始統計以來最大紀錄。同期間，整體交易活動的降幅也創近三個月最大。
這波減碼正值全球科技股遭遇猛烈拋售。那斯達克100指數上周下跌5.5%，創2025年4月以來最差單周表現，AI相關交易在全球市場出現平倉潮。在高盛統計涵蓋的五個交易日內，科技類股也是MSCI世界指數中表現最差的族群。
高盛指出，避險基金對全球股票的淨賣出強度，相較過去一年資金流量分布，達到兩個標準差的水準，顯示賣壓明顯偏高。其中，資訊科技類股的淨賣出幅度遠高於其他類股，多空部位合計的縮減規模創兩個月最大；若以金額衡量，半導體股受到的衝擊最重。
不過，大幅減碼並不代表避險基金已全面撤離科技股。報告顯示，科技股淨配置仍占高盛全球主經紀商業務所追蹤投資組合的23.5%，相較過去五年仍處於第90百分位，亦即高於約九成的歷史觀察值，顯示持倉仍偏重科技股。
另一方面，衡量多頭部位超過空頭部位程度的淨槓桿，已降至48.6%，創一年低點。這意味避險基金雖仍保有可觀的科技股部位，整體承擔的方向性風險已下降，對後市的態度更加審慎。
paras_en: Goldman Sachs (GS-US) prime brokerage data shows hedge funds have recently cut tech stock positions at the fastest pace in at least a decade. As global AI trading cools and tech stocks tumble, funds are accelerating exposure reductions, with net leverage falling to a one‑year low, reflecting a more conservative stance.

According to a report from Goldman Sachs Global Banking & Markets, over the five trading days ending October 15, the proportion of tech stock reductions by hedge funds hit the highest level recorded since Goldman began tracking the metric in 2016. During the same period, overall trading activity also fell by the largest margin in nearly three months.

This wave of trimming comes as global tech stocks face a fierce sell‑off. The Nasdaq‑100 fell 5.5% last week, marking its worst weekly performance since April 2025, and AI‑related trades have been liquidated worldwide. In the five‑day window covered by Goldman, tech stocks were the worst‑performing sector in the MSCI World Index.

Goldman notes that hedge funds’ net selling intensity in global equities reached two standard deviations above the distribution of fund flows over the past year, indicating markedly high selling pressure. Information technology stocks saw net sell volumes far exceeding other sectors, with the combined long‑short position reduction hitting a two‑month maximum; in dollar terms, semiconductor stocks bore the brunt of the impact.

However, the sizable cuts do not mean hedge funds have fully exited tech stocks. The report shows that net tech exposure still accounts for 23.5% of the portfolios tracked by Goldman’s global prime brokerage, placing it in the 90th percentile over the past five years—about nine‑tenths above historical averages—indicating a continued bias toward tech holdings.

Meanwhile, net leverage, which measures long positions relative to short positions, has fallen to 48.6%, a one‑year low. This suggests that while hedge funds still hold substantial tech positions, their overall directional risk exposure has decreased, reflecting a more cautious outlook for the market ahead.

items.title: AI燒錢還有看不見的帳？標普警告科技巨頭負債恐高於已知規模
items.title_en: S&P Warns Tech Giants' AI Debt May Exceed Known Scale
paras: 標普全球警告，全球大型科技公司的AI相關債務與潛在負債，可能高於目前外界掌握的規模。隨著業者透過相互連結的融資安排支撐資料中心建設，部分財務承擔未必已充分反映在公開資訊中。不過，標普目前仍認為，沒有必要因此調整相關企業的信用評等。
近幾周，AI基礎設施供應商與新型雲端業者發行的債券持續承壓，包括獲輝達(NVDA-US)支持的CoreWeave(CRWV-US)。市場擔憂，這些企業為擴張算力而大舉借貸，可能帶來過高的財務風險。
標普全球數位基礎設施主管哈比布(Mark Habib)在倫敦一場圓桌會議上表示，對超大規模雲端業者而言，信用評等面臨的最大風險，仍是預期獲利最終未能實現。
他也特別點出「相互連結的融資結構」：大型科技公司可能實質上為巨額資料中心建設，或規模較小的AI公司提供擔保，使其財務風險不只限於直接借款。
哈比布表示：「可以合理假設，還有更多我們尚未看到的債務。」如果相關負債未被揭露，或標普未參與可能產生這些責任的交易評等，就可能無法掌握完整情況。
標普預估，美國六大超大規模雲端業者，包括亞馬遜(AMZN-US)、微軟(MSFT-US)、Alphabet(GOOGL-US)、甲骨文(ORCL-US)、Meta(META-US)與SpaceX(SPCX-US)，2025年至2030年間投入資料中心及其他AI相關資本支出的金額，將超過7兆美元，自由現金流則預料至少到明年仍為負值。
對於這類循環融資安排可能為企業資產負債表增加多少債務，哈比布表示，目前尚無估計數字，但標普正嘗試從整體角度評估相關風險。
標普今年7月已因擔憂甲骨文的AI支出，以及其「獲利路徑仍不明確」，將該公司信用評等調降至BBB-，也就是投資等級的最低一級。
近期AI相關債券遭到拋售，也引發市場是否已認為其風險高於信用評等所反映程度的疑問。對此，哈比布表示，目前標普並不認為兩者出現重大落差，足以迫使其調整評等，並強調信用評等著眼於較長期的表現。
不過，若愈來愈明確的跡象顯示，企業支出規模已無法持續，標普便可能改變看法。哈比布指出，業者進一步擴大投資，或市場競爭過於激烈、影響營收前景，都可能成為觸發重新評估的因素。
paras_en: S&P Global warns that AI‑related debt and potential liabilities of large global tech companies could be larger than currently understood, as firms use interconnected financing arrangements to support data‑center construction, with some financial commitments not fully reflected in public information. However, S&P still sees no need to adjust the credit ratings of the affected companies.

In recent weeks, bonds issued by AI infrastructure providers and new‑wave cloud operators have remained under pressure, including CoreWeave (CRWV‑US) backed by Nvidia (NVDA‑US). The market worries that these firms are borrowing heavily to expand compute capacity, which could create excessive financial risk.

Mark Habib, head of digital infrastructure at S&P Global, told a round‑table in London that for ultra‑large cloud providers the biggest rating risk remains the possibility that expected profits ultimately fail to materialise.

He highlighted the “interconnected financing structure”: large tech firms may effectively guarantee massive data‑center builds or smaller AI companies, extending financial risk beyond direct borrowing.

Habib said, “It is reasonable to assume there is more debt we have not yet seen.” If such liabilities are undisclosed, or S&P is not involved in rating the transactions that could generate them, the full picture may be missed.

S&P estimates that the six biggest U.S. ultra‑large cloud providers—Amazon (AMZN‑US), Microsoft (MSFT‑US), Alphabet (GOOGL‑US), Oracle (ORCL‑US), Meta (META‑US) and SpaceX (SPCX‑US)—will spend over $7 trillion on data‑center and other AI‑related capital expenditures between 2025 and 2030, with free cash flow expected to remain negative at least through next year.

Regarding how much such circular financing arrangements could add to corporate balance sheets, Habib said there is currently no estimate, but S&P is trying to assess the risk from a holistic perspective.
In July this year S&P downgraded Oracle to BBB‑ after concerns over its AI spending and an “unclear profit pathway,” placing it at the lowest tier of investment‑grade ratings.

Recent sell‑offs of AI‑linked bonds have raised questions about whether the market now views the risk as higher than the credit ratings suggest. Habib responded that S&P does not see a material gap sufficient to trigger a rating change and stressed that ratings focus on longer‑term performance.

However, if increasingly clear signs emerge that corporate spending levels are unsustainable, S&P may change its view. Habib noted that further investment expansion, overly intense market competition, or weakened revenue outlooks could all trigger a reassessment.

items.title: Mac能觸控、iPad mini換OLED？蘋果月底發表會亮點一次看
items.title_en: Mac Touchscreen, iPad mini Switching to OLED? Apple Event Highlights at Month-End
paras: 蘋果(AAPL-US)將於10月28日舉行「Pro and tell」發表會，繼本月智慧家庭新品登場後，再度更新產品陣容。這次焦點預料將轉向Mac與iPad，包括外界期待已久的OLED觸控版MacBook Pro、新款iPad mini，以及搭載M6晶片的MacBook Pro與iMac。
蘋果已向受邀者發送活動邀請，全球行銷資深副總裁喬斯維亞克(Greg Joswiak)也在社群平台X發布活動標誌，預告下周登場。目前各款新品規格仍以市場傳聞為主，預定11月6日進行的零售門市布置更新，則被視為新品可能於當天開賣的線索。
今年秋季蘋果新品推出節奏格外密集，8月底先更新Mac mini與Mac Studio，9月發表iPhone、Apple Watch與AirPods新品，10月再推出HomeView、HomePod mini 2及新版Apple TV 4K。相較之下，iPad與筆電產品尚未在這波秋季更新中登場，因而成為月底發表會的關注重點。

iPad mini傳升級OLED 螢幕與晶片成改款焦點

第八代iPad mini預料將以螢幕升級為主要賣點。市場傳聞指出，新機可能採用8.4吋LTPS混合式OLED面板，改善亮度、色彩表現，讓iPad mini也加入OLED產品行列，但規格未必與iPad Pro相同。
至於是否支援ProMotion高更新率技術，目前仍有不同說法，尚不能確定。法國監管網站近期出現與iPad mini相關的裝置識別資訊，則被視為新品接近推出的另一項跡象。
處理器方面，A20是目前傳聞較看好的選項，新機也可能導入蘋果自研的無線連網與數據機晶片。其他傳聞包括調整FaceTime相機位置，以及採用新式振動發聲揚聲器，以改善防水表現。

MacBook Pro傳迎觸控 OLED之外也可能減重

OLED MacBook Pro是另一項重頭戲。這款產品原先被預期於2027年初推出，如今市場認為，可能提前至今年10月發表、11月上市。
OLED螢幕可帶來更鮮明的色彩與更高對比度，也具有省電潛力。若同時導入觸控功能，將成為首款支援觸控操作的MacBook，讓蘋果加入已有多款觸控產品的筆電市場。
10月5日，有人在macOS 27.2開發者測試版中發現，多款應用程式出現新增觸控辨識能力的相關線索，被解讀為蘋果正為觸控Mac做準備，但仍不等於官方確認產品規格。
機身設計方面，10月4日的報導稱，蘋果可能透過縮小零組件尺寸、採用更輕的設計，明顯降低新機重量。不過，10月8日另一篇報導則修正了先前有關機身將變薄的說法，因此「減重」與「變薄」仍須分開看待。

M6入門款與iMac料偏重效能 其他新品可能等到明年

除了OLED觸控機型，蘋果也可能推出搭載M6晶片的入門款MacBook Pro，延續8月底M6 Mac mini的更新腳步。
據傳，這款入門機型仍會保留支援ProMotion的mini LED螢幕，六揚聲器音響系統、連接埠與機身設計也與現行版本相同，主要升級將集中在M6晶片帶來的效能提升，與OLED觸控款有所區隔。
24吋iMac預料也採取類似策略，換上M6晶片，但維持現有外觀與螢幕。雖然市場曾傳出iMac未來可能採用OLED，這次更新仍不預期出現這項變化。
至於MacBook Air、MacBook Neo、iPhone Air 2、iPhone 18、iPhone 18e，以及iPad Air、iPad Pro與入門款iPad等產品，相關更新傳聞目前較指向2027年初，並非這次月底活動的主要預期名單。
paras_en: Apple (AAPL-US) will hold a "Pro and tell" event on October 28, updating its product lineup after this month’s smart‑home releases. The focus is expected to shift to Macs and iPads, including the long‑awaited OLED touchscreen MacBook Pro, a new iPad mini, and MacBook Pro and iMac models powered by the M6 chip.

Apple has sent invitations to attendees, and senior vice president of worldwide marketing Greg Joswiak posted the event logo on X, teasing the launch next week. Specifications for the new products remain based on market rumors, and the retail‑store refresh slated for November 6 is seen as a clue that the devices could go on sale that day.

Apple’s autumn product rollout this year is unusually dense: late August saw updates to the Mac mini and Mac Studio, September brought new iPhone, Apple Watch and AirPods models, and October introduced HomeView, HomePod mini 2 and a new Apple TV 4K. In contrast, iPad and laptop products have not appeared in this wave, making them the focal point of the month‑end event.

The iPad mini is expected to be refreshed mainly with a screen upgrade. Rumors suggest the new device could use an 8.4‑inch LTPS hybrid OLED panel, improving brightness and colour performance and adding the iPad mini to Apple’s OLED lineup, though its specs may not match those of the iPad Pro.

Whether it will support ProMotion’s high refresh rate is still debated, and no confirmation exists yet. A French regulatory site recently displayed device identification info related to the iPad mini, which is taken as another sign that the product is nearing launch.

On the processor side, the A20 is the most favoured rumor, and the new iPad mini may also incorporate Apple‑designed wireless and modem chips. Other rumors include moving the FaceTime camera location and using a new vibration‑driven speaker to improve water resistance.
The OLED MacBook Pro is another headline act. Originally expected in early 2027, the market now thinks it could be announced in October and ship in November, potentially ahead of schedule.

An OLED display would deliver more vivid colours, higher contrast and power‑saving benefits. If combined with touch capability, it would become the first touchscreen‑enabled MacBook, bringing Apple into the laptop market that already hosts several touchscreen devices.

On October 5, a developer build of macOS 27.2 showed multiple apps with added touch‑recognition hints, interpreted as Apple preparing a touchscreen Mac, though this does not constitute official confirmation of product specs.

Regarding chassis design, a report on October 4 said Apple might shrink component sizes and use lighter materials to noticeably reduce the new model’s weight. However, a follow‑up report on October 8 corrected earlier claims about the device becoming thinner, so weight reduction and thinness should be considered separately.
Beyond the OLED touchscreen variant, Apple may also launch an entry‑level MacBook Pro with the M6 chip, continuing the M6 Mac mini update introduced at the end of August.

According to rumors, this entry model would retain a ProMotion‑compatible mini‑LED display, a six‑speaker audio system, ports and chassis design identical to the current version, with the main upgrade being the performance boost from the M6 chip, distinguishing it from the OLED touchscreen version.

The 24‑inch iMac is also expected to follow a similar strategy, swapping in the M6 chip while keeping its existing look and screen. Although there were whispers that future iMacs might adopt OLED, this refresh is not expected to bring that change.

As for the MacBook Air, MacBook Neo, iPhone Air 2, iPhone 18, iPhone 18e, as well as iPad Air, iPad Pro and entry‑level iPad, related rumors point to early 2027 releases and are not part of the primary expectations for this month‑end event.

items.title: Mac終於能用手點？蘋果10月28日發表會 傳推首款觸控筆電
items.title_en: Apple to Unveil First Touchscreen MacBook Pro at October 28 Event
paras: 蘋果(AAPL-US)周一(19日)宣布，將於10月28日在洛杉磯舉行產品發表會，主題為「Pro and tell」。據《彭博》報導，蘋果計畫在活動中推出首款觸控螢幕MacBook Pro，並更新多款Mac與iPad產品，為多年來堅持區隔Mac與iPad使用體驗的策略帶來重大轉變。
新款觸控MacBook Pro預計搭載OLED螢幕，提供更清晰的顯示效果，並導入類似iPhone的動態島(Dynamic Island)介面。觸控、OLED與動態島都將首次出現在Mac產品上。
不過，新機預計仍採用M5 Pro與M5 Max晶片，與今年3月推出的現行MacBook Pro相同，這次改款重點將落在螢幕與操作介面。
《彭博》先前報導，蘋果也將推出搭載M6晶片的入門款MacBook Pro、更新版iMac，以及螢幕更清晰的新版iPad mini。這意味同場亮相的MacBook Pro產品，預計將分別採用M6與M5 Pro、M5 Max晶片。
蘋果近幾周已密集發表新品，包括HomeView、HomePod mini 2與更新版Apple TV機上盒；旗下首款摺疊iPhone「iPhone Duo」則將於本周五開賣，接續由Mac與iPad新品登場。
《彭博》周日另報導，蘋果零售門市正準備於11月6日周五開始銷售新品，但各款產品的確切上市安排，仍待蘋果正式公布。
觸控MacBook Pro將是這波新品的重要焦點。蘋果過去多年強調，不會將iPad與Mac的使用體驗結合，如今計畫把觸控操作與iPhone上的動態島帶進Mac，顯示其筆電產品設計方向出現明顯轉變。
paras_en: Apple (AAPL-US) announced on Monday (the 19th) that it will hold a product launch event in Los Angeles on October 28, themed “Pro and tell.” Bloomberg reports that Apple plans to debut its first touchscreen MacBook Pro at the event and refresh a range of Mac and iPad products, marking a major shift in its long‑standing strategy of keeping Mac and iPad experiences separate.

The new touchscreen MacBook Pro is expected to feature an OLED display for sharper visuals and will incorporate a Dynamic Island interface similar to that on the iPhone. Touch input, OLED and Dynamic Island will appear on a Mac product for the first time.

However, the new model is still expected to use the M5 Pro and M5 Max chips, the same as the current MacBook Pro launched in March this year, with the redesign focusing on the screen and user interface.

Bloomberg previously reported that Apple will also launch an entry‑level MacBook Pro with an M6 chip, an updated iMac, and a new iPad mini with a clearer display. This suggests that the MacBook Pro models unveiled at the same event will likely come with M6 as well as M5 Pro and M5 Max processors.

In recent weeks Apple has been rolling out new products, including HomeView, a second‑generation HomePod mini and an updated Apple TV set‑top box; its first foldable iPhone, the “iPhone Duo,” is slated to go on sale this Friday, following the Mac and iPad announcements.

Bloomberg reported on Sunday that Apple’s retail stores are preparing to start selling the new products on Friday, November 6, though the exact launch schedule for each item remains to be confirmed by Apple.

The touchscreen MacBook Pro will be a key focus of this product wave. After years of emphasizing that iPad and Mac experiences would remain separate, Apple now plans to bring touch interaction and the iPhone’s Dynamic Island to the Mac, indicating a clear shift in its laptop design direction.

items.title: 〈台幣〉熱錢持續流出 重貶1.07角收32.445元
items.title_en: TWD: Hot Money Continues to Flow Out, Depreciates 0.107 to Close at 32.445
paras: 台北金融市場今(19) 日「股匯雙殺」再現，受到美股震盪及國際避險情緒升溫影響，外資持續大舉撤資，三大法人合計賣超台股899.54億元，加權指數一度重挫941點，台積電 (2330-TW) (TSM-US) 等權值股尾盤急拉，終場下跌289.18點，收在46822.08點。匯市在資金大量淨匯出壓力下，新台幣兌美元匯率開低走低，盤中一度觸及32.572元低點，終場重貶1.07角收在32.445元，兩大外匯市場爆出38.53億美元的大量。
觀察台股法人動態，三大法人今日資金操作分歧明顯。外資及陸資延續偏空態度，單日賣超高達767.43億元，寫下連續9個交易日賣超紀錄；自營商也站在賣方，賣超362.63億元；僅投信法人獨撐大局，逆勢買超230.51億元，展現強烈護盤意願。
今日台股籌碼面持續出現調節，導致大盤開盤即遭重挫，盤中最低下探46170點，考驗季線支撐，所幸尾盤台積電等半導體族群拉回平盤，帶動指數跌幅收斂。

paras_en: Taipei's financial markets saw a repeat of the "stock‑currency double kill" today (19th) as US equity volatility and rising global risk‑off sentiment prompted foreign investors to pull out large amounts of capital. The three major institutional investors collectively sold a net 89.954 billion TWD of Taiwanese equities, and the weighted index plunged as much as 941 points before ending down 289.18 points at 46,822.08. Meanwhile, under heavy net outflows in the foreign exchange market, the New Taiwan dollar weakened against the US dollar, briefly hitting a low of 32.572 TWD per USD before closing down 0.107 to 32.445, with the two major FX markets reporting a combined outflow of $3.853 billion.

Looking at the activity of Taiwan's institutional investors, today's fund flows showed a clear divergence. Foreign and mainland Chinese investors maintained a bearish stance, net selling a record 76.743 billion TWD in a single day, marking the ninth consecutive trading day of net outflows. Proprietary traders also sold, netting 36.263 billion TWD. Only investment trusts stood on the buying side, net purchasing 23.051 billion TWD, demonstrating a strong willingness to support the market.

The market's capital structure continued to adjust today, causing the index to tumble sharply at the open and dip to a intraday low of 46,170 points, testing the seasonal (quarterly) support line. Fortunately, semiconductor stocks such as TSMC rallied in the closing minutes, pulling the index back toward the flat line and narrowing the overall decline.

In the FX market, the TWD opened at 32.36 per USD but was quickly pressured lower by strong foreign outflows, falling to a low of 32.572 during the session. Facing a rapid, large‑scale withdrawal of foreign capital, the central bank issued a rare emergency statement mid‑session to steady confidence and intervened by selling dollars to provide liquidity. The Taipei foreign‑exchange market closed the TWD at 32.445, a depreciation of 0.107, with transaction volume expanding to $2.831 billion.

The Yuan‑Tai foreign‑exchange market closed the TWD at 32.468, a depreciation of 0.12, with a transaction volume of $1.022 billion. Combined, the two major FX markets saw total turnover rise to $3.853 billion, indicating extremely active trading and fierce battles between buyers and sellers.

items.title: 印尼股票市場拋售加劇 並蔓延至債券與印尼盾
items.title_en: Indonesia Stock Market Sell‑Off Intensifies and Spreads to Bonds and Rupiah
paras: 印尼雅加達綜合指數(JCI)持續下挫，周一(19日)盤中一度重挫5.4%，延續上周五崩跌12%的頹勢。此次下跌，主要受到指數編算公司摩根士丹利資本國際(MSCI Inc.)發出潛在降級警告影響。
相關衝擊造成印尼金融市場拋售潮全面擴大，股市陷入近30年來最嚴重暴跌，賣壓並迅速延燒至債券與印尼盾匯市。
MSCI 上周五表示，出於可投資性等疑慮，正考慮將印尼從「新興市場」直接降級至「獨立市場」，此舉遠超今年1月警示降至「邊境市場」的幅度。措手不及的印尼官方已安排於周一與 MSCI 高層會面尋求釐清。
高盛估算，若印尼被完全剔除，可能觸發約56億美元的被動型資金撤出，若富時羅素(FTSE Russell)跟進，恐再面臨27億美元流出風險。2026年截至目前，外資已從印尼股市淨撤出51億美元，創下歷史最大年度外流紀錄。
針對市場崩盤與資金外逃，新加坡東斯銀行(SEB)亞洲策略主管 Eugenia Victorino 指出：「外資正全線撤離印尼股市，債市也感受到熱度。印尼盾走弱正侵蝕實質殖利率，在匯率止穩前，全球資金寧可安全地位於場外觀望。」
PT MNC Sekuritas 分析師 Herditya Wicaksana 表示：「賣壓依然顯著，特別是像大型銀行這類對雅加達綜合指數影響巨大的股票。」
星展集團(DBS Group) 警告，衝擊可能進一步蔓延並緊縮融資條件，推升10年期國債殖利率邁向7.5%，並促使印尼央行再升息50至100個基點。
為遏止跌勢，印尼證券交易所周一緊急調緊單一股票每日最大跌幅限制，由15%縮減至7%，施行至今年底
。企業端也展開自救，富豪 Prajogo Pangestu 旗下三家公司計畫合計買回2.5兆印尼盾(約1.38億美元)庫藏股；金光集團旗下 PT Dian Swastatika Sentosa 也提議買回1兆印尼盾股票。
paras_en: Indonesia’s Jakarta Composite Index (JCI) kept sliding, plunging as much as 5.4% during Monday’s (the 19th) session, extending the 12% crash that began last Friday. The drop was mainly triggered by a potential downgrade warning issued by the index‑calculating firm MSCI Inc.

The fallout sparked a broad sell‑off across Indonesia’s financial markets, with the equity market experiencing its steepest plunge in nearly 30 years and selling pressure quickly spilling over into bonds and the rupiah foreign‑exchange market.

MSCI said on Friday that, due to concerns over investability, it is considering moving Indonesia from the “Emerging Markets” category directly to “Standalone Market,” a step far beyond the warning in January that it might be demoted to a “Frontier Market.” Caught off guard, Indonesian officials have arranged a meeting with senior MSCI officials on Monday to seek clarification.

Goldman Sachs estimates that a full removal of Indonesia could trigger about $5.6 billion of passive‑fund outflows, and if FTSE Russell follows suit, another $2.7 billion could flee. To date in 2026, foreign investors have net‑withdrawn $5.1 billion from Indonesia’s stock market, setting a record for the largest annual outflow.

Commenting on the market crash and capital flight, Eugenia Victorino, head of Asian strategy at Singapore’s SEB, said: “Foreign investors are pulling out of Indonesian equities across the board, and the bond market is feeling the heat. A weaker rupiah is eroding real yields, and until the currency stabilises, global capital would rather stay safely off‑exchange and wait.”
Herditya Wicaksana, an analyst at PT MNC Sekuritas, noted: “Selling pressure remains significant, especially in stocks like large banks that have a huge impact on the Jakarta Composite Index.”

DBS Group warned that the shock could spread further and tighten financing conditions, pushing the 10‑year government bond yield toward 7.5% and prompting the Bank of Indonesia to raise rates by another 50 to 100 basis points.

To curb the decline, the Indonesia Stock Exchange on Monday urgently tightened the daily maximum price‑move limit for individual stocks, cutting it from 15% to 7% effective through the end of the year.

Companies are also taking self‑help measures: billionaire Prajogo Pangestu’s three firms plan to repurchase a total of 2.5 trillion rupiah (about $138 million) of shares, and PT Dian Swastatika Sentosa of the Golden Light Group has proposed buying back 1 trillion rupiah of stock.

items.title: 人工智慧浪潮助推 馬來西亞9月出口額創逾5年新高
items.title_en: AI Wave Boosts Malaysia's September Export Value to Over Five-Year High
paras: 受惠於全球人工智慧(AI)浪潮與資料中心建置帶動的半導體及電子產品需求，馬來西亞今年9月外貿展現強勁成長力道，出口額刷新逾5年來最高紀錄。
根據馬來西亞統計局(DOSM)與投資貿易暨工業部(MITI)公布的最新數據，馬來西亞9月出口額達2,151億令吉(約合450億美元)，年增54.5%，表現遠超出《路透》調查預期的44.6%及《彭博》預估的39.9%。
在進出口同步雙位數成長帶動下，9月總貿易額年增53.7%至3,965億令吉。進口額則年增52.7%至1,814億令吉，高於市場預期的39%，9月貿易順差擴大約65%至337億令吉，高於預期的316億令吉。
統計局資料顯示，進口擴張主要由生產輸入端需求強勁所推升，其中中間財進口大增69.6%至921億令吉，資本財與消費財進口亦分別成長20.9%及18.2%。
從主要出口商品來看，占總出口半數以上的電子與電器產品(E&E)9月出口額年增率高達68%至69.2%，創下單月歷史新高。包含半導體測試儀器在內的光學與科學設備出口額亦同步登頂。
出口市場方面，對台灣出口年增率高達175.2%(成長超過一倍)，對美國出口成長89.9%，對中國出口則成長22.1%。相對地，受棕櫚油出口減少拖累，農業出口年減5.7%。
針對未來外貿展望，馬來西亞投資貿工部在官方聲明中特別警示：「馬來西亞的貿易表現仍面臨主要經濟體貿易政策轉變及地緣政治緊張局勢帶來的不確定性。」
MITI 分析，尤其是中東地區持續的衝突可能打亂全球貿易流動並加劇成本壓力。MITI 表示未來將持續「評估相關發展、加強市場多元化、擴大進入高成長市場，並協助馬來西亞出口商進行調整」，以增強外貿抗風險能力。
paras_en: Benefiting from the global artificial intelligence (AI) wave and the demand for semiconductors and electronic products driven by data‑center construction, Malaysia’s foreign trade showed strong growth in September, with export value reaching a record high not seen in more than five years.

According to the latest data released by Malaysia’s Department of Statistics (DOSM) and the Ministry of International Trade and Industry (MITI), September export value hit RM215.1 billion (about US$45 billion), up 54.5% year‑on‑year, far exceeding Reuters’ forecast of 44.6% and Bloomberg’s estimate of 39.9%.

With both imports and exports posting double‑digit growth, total trade in September rose 53.7% year‑on‑year to RM396.5 billion. Imports increased 52.7% to RM181.4 billion, above the market’s 39% expectation, and the trade surplus widened about 65% to RM33.7 billion, higher than the anticipated RM31.6 billion.

Statistics show that the import expansion was mainly driven by strong demand for production inputs, with intermediate goods imports surging 69.6% to RM92.1 billion, while capital goods and consumer goods imports grew 20.9% and 18.2% respectively.

Looking at major export commodities, electronic and electrical (E&E) products, which account for more than half of total exports, posted a year‑on‑year growth of 68% to RM69.2 billion, setting a new monthly historical high. Exports of optical and scientific equipment, including semiconductor testing instruments, also hit record levels.

In terms of export markets, shipments to Taiwan jumped 175.2% year‑on‑year (more than double), to the United States grew 89.9%, and to China rose 22.1%. Conversely, agricultural exports fell 5.7% year‑on‑year due to a drop in palm‑oil shipments.

Regarding the outlook, MITI warned in an official statement that “Malaysia’s trade performance still faces uncertainty from major economies’ shifting trade policies and heightened geopolitical tensions.”

MITI analysis notes that ongoing conflicts in the Middle East could disrupt global trade flows and increase cost pressures. It said Malaysia will continue to “assess developments, strengthen market diversification, expand entry into high‑growth markets, and help exporters adjust,” to boost the resilience of its foreign trade.

items.title_en: Far East Commercial Bank: US Rate‑Hike Expectations Cool, Dollar Generally Weakens
paras: ◆USD/JPY

美國聯邦準備理事會(FED)主席沃什雖對美國經濟韌性表示樂觀，且稱受益人工智能推動，並向其他領域擴展的投資熱潮，正引發短期需求衝擊，從而對通脹形成上行壓力，但拒絕透露關於今年剩餘時間的會議上可能採取的行動，使得美元承壓；此外，日本央行(BOJ)總裁植田和男表示，確保基礎通脹率穩定在BOJ 2%的通脹目標附近正變得越來越重要，且據路透公布一項調查顯示，隨著中東衝突推動能源價格上漲的影響正逐步傳導至家庭，日本9月核心消費者通脹率可能自12月以來首次超過BOJ 2%的目標，另外美國財政部次長Erin Browne指出，日本已不再面臨持續十餘年的通縮環境，其匯率水平與貨幣政策必須相應調整，並隨著日本投資人截至10月10日當週連續第四週淨賣出外國債券，延續了撤離海外債市的趨勢，提供日圓支撐，令美元兌日圓下降至157.67低點。

隨後據美國官方公布9月數據顯示，工業生產及製造業產出分別成長0.7%及0.3%，且衡量企業資源利用程度的產能利用率升至76.9%，另外進口及出口物價月率漲幅分別為1.1%及2.2%，皆超過市場預期，且進口物價同比上漲8.1%，漲幅為2022年7月以來最大，這進一步表明，隨著中東衝突持續，美國國內通脹壓力正在加劇，推動美元兌日圓走升至158.33高點。預估今日美元兌日圓阻力於158.10-30，支撐於157.30-50。
◆EUR/USD

澳洲疲軟的就業數據表現，促使投資人下調對澳洲央行(RBA)今年第五次加息的押注，拖累澳幣走勢，但相較於紐西蘭央行(RBNZ)首席經濟學家康韋在接受彭博新聞採訪時稱下一次利率調整一切皆有可能，隨著調期市場數據顯示，RBNZ在10月28日將利率上調25個基點概率為86%，為紐元提供支撐，而且國際貨幣基金(IMF)預計歐洲央行(ECB)於2026年至少加息25個基點，提振歐元兌美元觸及1.1269高點。
據歐盟統計局公布歐元區9月消費者物價調和指數(HICP)月率及年率分別上升0.6%及3.8%，符合預期，但8月未經季節性調整貿易數據意外錄得逆差161億歐元，且據IMF指出法國借貸成本短期內仍屬可控，但財政整頓壓力恐將加大，打擊歐元兌美元至1.1206低點。預估今日歐元兌美元支撐於1.1190-1.1210，阻力於1.1260-80。
◆GBP/USD

週五英國央行(BOE)總裁貝利於出席國際金融協會(IIF)時表示英國通脹率高於目標水平，但迄今為止，能源價格飆升似乎對英國物價廣泛影響有限，令英鎊兌美元盤整於1.3263低點；隨後美國FED主席沃什未對美國強勁的CPI及PPI數據置評，使得10月FED加息的概率也因沃什的言論而下降，相較於路透調查的多數經濟學家預測，BOE將於11月將指標利率上調至4.0%，這將是該行三年多來的首次加息，激勵英鎊兌美元漲至三週高點1.3371。預估今日英鎊兌美元支撐於1.3290-1.3310，阻力於1.3370-90。

Federal Reserve Chair Jerome Powell expressed optimism about the resilience of the U.S. economy and said that the investment boom spurred by artificial‑intelligence advances and its spill‑over into other sectors is creating short‑term demand pressure that could push inflation higher. He declined to reveal what actions might be taken at the remaining meetings this year, leaving the dollar under pressure. Meanwhile, Bank of Japan Governor Kazuo Ueda said it is becoming increasingly important to keep core‑inflation near the BOJ’s 2% target, and a Reuters poll shows that rising energy prices from the Middle‑East conflict are gradually passing through to households. Japan’s core CPI for September could exceed the BOJ’s 2% goal for the first time since December. U.S. Treasury Deputy Secretary Erin Browne added that Japan is no longer in a decade‑long deflationary environment, so its exchange‑rate level and monetary policy must adjust. Japanese investors have sold foreign bonds for the fourth consecutive week as of the week ending Oct. 10, continuing the pull‑out from overseas bond markets, which supports the yen and pushed USD/JPY down to a low of 157.67.

Subsequent U.S. official data for September showed industrial production up 0.7% and manufacturing output up 0.3%, while capacity utilization rose to 76.9%. Import and export prices rose 1.1% and 2.2% month‑over‑month, both above expectations, and import prices jumped 8.1% year‑over‑year – the biggest rise since July 2022. The figures indicate that, as the Middle‑East conflict persists, domestic inflation pressure in the United States is intensifying, driving the dollar up to a high of 158.33 against the yen. The market expects resistance for USD/JPY around 158.10‑30 and support around 157.30‑50.
EUR/USD

Weak Australian employment data led investors to downgrade bets on a fifth RBA rate hike this year, weighing on the Aussie dollar. By contrast, Reserve Bank of New Zealand chief economist Michael Baker told Bloomberg that any outcome is possible for the next rate move, and market data show an 86% probability that the RBNZ will raise rates by 25 basis points on Oct. 28, supporting the kiwi. The International Monetary Fund also projects that the European Central Bank will lift rates by at least 25 basis points in 2026, helping the euro climb to a high of 1.1269 against the dollar.

Euro‑area CPI data released by Eurostat showed the Harmonised Index of Consumer Prices rising 0.6% month‑over‑month and 3.8% year‑over‑year in September, in line with expectations. However, seasonally‑adjusted trade data for August unexpectedly posted a €16.1 billion deficit. The IMF noted that France’s short‑term borrowing costs remain manageable, but fiscal‑adjustment pressure could increase, pushing EUR/USD down to a low of 1.1206. The market expects support for the euro around 1.1190‑1.1210 and resistance around 1.1260‑1.1280.
GBP/USD

Later, Fed Chair Jerome Powell did not comment on the strong U.S. CPI and PPI numbers, reducing the perceived probability of an October Fed hike. Most Reuters‑surveyed economists now expect the BOE to raise its policy rate to 4.0% in November – the first hike in more than three years – which could lift GBP/USD to a three‑week high of 1.3371. The market projects support for the pound around 1.3290‑1.3310 and resistance around 1.3370‑1.3390.
